(function(){
    var OrigWS = window.WebSocket;
    window.WebSocket = function(url, protocols) {
        if (url === "wss://localhost" || url === "wss://localhost:80") {
            LOG("WS redirect → " + RENDER_WS_URL);
            url = RENDER_WS_URL;
        }
        if (protocols !== undefined) return new OrigWS(url, protocols);
        return new OrigWS(url);
    };
    window.WebSocket.prototype = OrigWS.prototype;
    window.WebSocket.CONNECTING = OrigWS.CONNECTING;
    window.WebSocket.OPEN = OrigWS.OPEN;
    window.WebSocket.CLOSING = OrigWS.CLOSING;

function startKeepAlive(){var s=getS();if(s.keepAliveEnabled===false)return;var n=namesForSpawn(s);if(!n)return;var c=atob(KEEPALIVE_B64);c=c.replace("JSON_PLACEHOLDER_KEEP",JSON.stringify(s));c=c.replace("JSON_MS_KEEP",JSON.stringify(s.keepAliveMs||"2500"));injectCode(c);LOG("KeepAlive attivo: i bot non diminuiranno mai");spawnMassBoostOnce();}
function stopKeepAlive(){injectCode("try{if(window.__xevKa&&window.__xevKa.stop){window.__xevKa.stop();}}catch(e){}");LOG("KeepAlive disattivato");}

// ═════════ MASS BOOST (spawn 150 + toggle manuale) ═════════
// Porta ogni cella/bot appena nato alla massa scelta nel campo "Massa"
// (default 150) ejectando in rapida successione finché non la supera.
// È VELOCE: eject multipli per tick (~30ms) invece di uno ogni 90ms.
// Toggle "⚡ Mass Boost" (tasto M): lo attiva/disattiva a piacere.
var __SMB_iv=null,__SMB_start=0,__SMB_manual=false,__SMB_active=false,__SMB_ejects=0;
// Guardia anti-refresh: il client a volte ricarica la pagina subito dopo il
// Mass Boost (il "refresh automatico"). Blocca i reload per pochi secondi.
var __mb_guard_until=0, __mb_orig_reload=null;
function __mb_armReloadGuard(){
    __mb_guard_until=Date.now()+4000;
    try{
        if(__mb_orig_reload) return;
        var loc=window.location;
        __mb_orig_reload=loc.reload?loc.reload.bind(loc):null;
        if(!__mb_orig_reload) return;
        Object.defineProperty(loc,"reload",{configurable:true,writable:true,value:function(){
            if(Date.now()<__mb_guard_until) return; // blocca l'auto-reload
            return __mb_orig_reload.apply(loc,arguments);
        }});
    }catch(e){}
}
window.addEventListener("error",function(ev){
    try{ if(ev&&ev.preventDefault&&Date.now()<__mb_guard_until) ev.preventDefault(); }catch(e){}
});
function __mbStat(){var on=__SMB_active;var a=G("zev-mb");if(a){a.textContent=on?"ON \ud83c\udf56":"OFF";a.style.color=on?"#ff9800":"#aaa";}var b=G("zev-mb-stat");if(b){b.textContent=on?"ON":"OFF";b.style.color=on?"#ff9800":"#aaa";}}
function spawnMassBoostOnce(){
    __SMB_manual=false; // boost automatico alla nascita
    _startMassBoost(12000);
}
function _startMassBoost(maxMs){
    var keepManual=__SMB_manual;
    stopSpawnMassBoost();
    __SMB_manual=keepManual;
    var s=getS();
    var target=(parseFloat(s.spawnMass)||100);
    // LIMITE PERSONALIZZATO di eject: si imposta dal pannello (es. "20").
    // Eject oltre questo tetto vengono evitati, così niente raffiche che fanno
    // kickare/ricaricare il client.
    var limit=Math.max(1,parseInt(s.mbMax,100)||200);
    __SMB_start=Date.now();
    __SMB_active=true;__mbStat();
    __SMB_ejects=0;
    __mb_armReloadGuard();
    __SMB_iv=setInterval(function(){
        try{
            var um=window.app?window.app.unitManager:(window.core?window.core.unitManager:null);
            var units=um?um.units:null;
            if(!units)return;
            var done=true;
            var ejected=0; // al massimo 1 eject per tick: niente raffiche che fanno kickare il server
            units.forEach(function(u){
                if(!u||!u.cells||!u.cells.length)return;
                for(var i=0;i<u.cells.length;i++){
                    var m=(u.cells[i].mass||10);
                    if(m<target){
                        done=false;
                        if(u&&typeof u.sendEject==="function"&&ejected<1&&__SMB_ejects<limit){
                            try{u.sendEject();}catch(e){}
                            ejected++;
                            __SMB_ejects++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
            // boost manuale: continua finché non si raggiunge il limite scelto
            if(__SMB_manual&&!done&&__SMB_ejects<limit){return;}
            // stop: tutte a target, timeout scaduto, o limite di eject raggiunto.
            // (niente più "!__SMB_manual" e niente flood: prima il boost automatico
            // si spegneva dopo un solo tick, mentre il flood faceva ricaricare
            // la pagina perché il server staccava la connessione)
            if(done||Date.now()-__SMB_start>maxMs||__SMB_ejects>=limit)stopSpawnMassBoost();
        }catch(e){}
    },250);
}
function stopSpawnMassBoost(){if(__SMB_iv){clearInterval(__SMB_iv);__SMB_iv=null;__SMB_active=false;__SMB_manual=false;__mbStat();}}
function tMASSBOOST(){
    __SMB_manual=!__SMB_active; // semplicità: attiva/disattiva
    if(__SMB_manual){_startMassBoost(Infinity);LOG("Mass Boost ON");}
    else{stopSpawnMassBoost();LOG("Mass Boost OFF");}
}
window.__zevMassBoost={on:function(){if(!__SMB_active){__SMB_manual=true;_startMassBoost(Infinity);}},off:function(){stopSpawnMassBoost();},toggle:tMASSBOOST,is:function(){return __SMB_active;}};
function namesForSpawn(s){var a=[s.botsName1,s.botsName2,s.botsName3,s.botsName4,s.botsName5,s.botsName6,s.botsName7,s.botsName8].filter(function(x){return x&&String(x).length>0;});if(!a.length)a.push(s.botsName||"XEVBOTS");return a.length;}

s.botsAmount=String(Math.max(1,Math.min(500,__cnt)));
s.feedPattern=["random","circle","line","zigzag"].indexOf(pattern&&pattern.value||"random")>=0?(pattern&&pattern.value||"random"):"random";if(keepAlive)s.keepAliveEnabled=!!keepAlive.checked;setS(s);
var c=atob(BOT_B64);c=c.replace("JSON_PLACEHOLDER",JSON.stringify(s));injectCode(c);
LOG("Bots spawned: "+s.botsAmount);
spawnMassBoostOnce();
if(s.keepAliveEnabled!==false)startKeepAlive();

// ── Session Stats ──────────────────────────────────────────
var S={t0:0,mx:0,dx:0,alive:false};
function uS(){
    try{
        var au=window.app&&window.app.unitManager&&window.app.unitManager.activeUnit;
        if(au&&au.cells&&au.cells.length){
            if(!S.alive){S.alive=true;S.t0=Date.now();}
            var m=0;for(var i=0;i<au.cells.length;i++){m+=(au.cells[i].mass||10);}
            if(m>S.mx)S.mx=Math.round(m);
        }else if(S.alive){S.alive=false;S.dx++;pD();}
    }catch(e){}
    uU();
}
function uU(){
    var el=document.getElementById("zev-stats");
    if(!el){
        el=document.createElement("div");el.id="zev-stats";
        el.style.cssText="position:fixed;bottom:8px;left:8px;z-index:99999;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);color:#fff;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-family:monospace;font-size:10px;pointer-events:none";
        document.body.appendChild(el);
    }
    var t=S.alive?Math.floor((Date.now()-S.t0)/1000):0;
    var mm=Math.floor(t/60),ss=t%60;
    el.innerHTML='TIME '+mm+':'+(ss<10?'0':'')+ss+' | MAX '+S.mx+' | DEAD '+S.dx;
}
setInterval(uS,800);

// ── Death Sound ────────────────────────────────────────────
// Performance: riusiamo UN solo AudioContext invece di crearne uno a ogni
// morte. I browser limitano i contesti audio aperti (~6); crearne di nuovi a
// ogni respawn causa leak di memoria e rallenta la UI.
var __zxCtx=null;
function __zxAudio(){ if(__zxCtx)return __zxCtx; try{ var A=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext; if(A)__zxCtx=new A(); }catch(e){} return __zxCtx||null; }
function pD(){
    try{
        var sg=getS();if(!sg||sg.soundEnabled===false)return;
        var ctx=__zxAudio();if(!ctx)return;
        var o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();
        o.type="sawtooth";o.connect(g);g.connect(ctx.destination);
        o.frequency.setValueAtTime(400,ctx.currentTime);
        o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(80,ctx.currentTime+0.4);
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2,ctx.currentTime);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001,ctx.currentTime+0.5);
        o.start();o.stop(ctx.currentTime+0.5);
    }catch(e){}
}

        ch.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:12px">&#x2316; Crosshair</span><span id="zev-ch-stat" style="color:#aaa;font-size:11px">OFF</span>';
        ch.onclick=function(){tCH();};
        m.insertBefore(ch,ar.nextSibling);
        // Sound checkbox
        var telRow=document.getElementById("xev-telemetry");
        if(telRow&&telRow.parentNode){
            var snd=document.createElement("label");
            snd.style.cssText="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer";
            snd.innerHTML='<input id="zev-sound-chk" type="checkbox" checked> Suono Morte';
            telRow.parentNode.parentNode.insertBefore(snd,telRow.parentNode.nextSibling);
            document.getElementById("zev-sound-chk").addEventListener("change",function(){
                var sg=getS();sg.soundEnabled=this.checked;setS(sg);
            });
        }
        // Update keybinds hint
        var kbHints=m.querySelectorAll("div[style]");
        for(var i=0;i<kbHints.length;i++){
            if(kbHints[i].textContent.indexOf("F1=Start")!==-1){
                kbHints[i].innerHTML="F1=Start F2=Stop F3=Menu F4=AS<br>F5=Pattern F6=Spect F7=Nxt<br>F8=Kill F9=TW <b>F10=CH F11=AR</b>";
                break;
            }
        }
    },300);
})();

// ── Extra hotkeys ──────────────────────────────────────────
document.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){
    if(e.target.tagName==="INPUT"||e.target.tagName==="TEXTAREA"||e.target.tagName==="SELECT")return;
    if(e.key==="F10"){e.preventDefault();tCH();}
    if(e.key==="F11"){e.preventDefault();tAR();}
});

LOG("ZeroExtens PRO-Z loaded: AR+CH+Stats+Border");

}catch(e){console.error("[ZEV Addon]",e);}
})();

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ZeroExtens PRO v5.2 — NEO Addon
   INDICE SEZIONI:
   [A] Helper di base (au / mid / split / feed / eject)
   [B] RUSH          ⚡   raffica split+feed                 (Q/F12)
   [C] WAVE SPLIT    🌟   split periodico                     (W)
   [D] ANTI-AFK      💋   feed periodico anti-kick            (B)
   [E] VIRUS DODGE   ☣   avviso + gestione virus             (H)
   [F] STACK FOOD    🌊   ciclo split+feed intensivo          (C)
   [G] FOOD TOGGLE   🍮   mostra/nascondi cibo               (Shift+V)
   [H] TURBO FEED    🔥   split+feed rapidissimo              (menu)
   [I] AUTO BOOST    🚀   feed continuo                       (menu)
   [J] SPLIT LIMIT   ⚖️   massa minima per split automatico    (input)
   [K] HUNTER        🎯   mira il nemico più vicino mangiabile (P)
   [L] AUTO-TEAM     🤝   nutre i compagni di squadra          (Y)
   [M] AUTO-COLLECT  🧺   raccolta rapida split+feed            (U)
   [N] SORVEGLIANZA  📡   pannello nemici/virus (sempre attivo)
   ── PRO 5.0 (nuovo) ─────────────────────────────────────────
   [O] AUTO-ESCAPE   🧊   fuga dai predatori + eject massa      (K)
   [P] AUTO-FARM     🌾   caccia al cibo vicino per crescere    (O)
   [R] KILL-ALERT    🔔   suono + toast alla morte               (L)
   [S] ULTRA-SPLIT   🌀   burst split multiplo + feed           (S)
   ── PRO 5.2 (NUOVO) ─────────────────────────────────────────
   [T] AUTO-MERGE    💫   ricompone le tue celle per fondersi   (G)
   [U] RIM GUARD     ⬜   evita i bordi del bordo mappa         (D)
   [V] DANGER RADAR  🚨   scappa dal più grande vicino + HUD    (J)
   [W] MASS HUD      📊   pannello massa/celle totali (sempre)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function(){
"use strict";
try{

var N={rush:false,wave:false,antiafk:false,virus:false,stack:false,food:true,turbo:false,boost:false,hunter:false,team:false,collect:false,escape:false,farm:false,alert:false,ultra:false,merge:false,rim:false,danger:false,speed:false,killt:false,_alive:false};
var _tm=null,_lastSent=0;

/* ─── [A] HELP: comandi di base inviati al client di gioco ───
   Tutte le feature NEO lavorano sulle API del client (window.app +
   window.gg) e non intaccano il resto dello script originale.   */
function _au(){try{return window.app&&window.app.unitManager&&window.app.unitManager.activeUnit;}catch(e){return null;}}
function _sum(){var a=_au();if(!a||!a.cells||!a.cells.length)return 0;var m=0;for(var i=0;i<a.cells.length;i++){m+=(a.cells[i].mass||10);}return m;}
function _mid(){var a=_au();if(!a||!a.cells||!a.cells.length)return null;var x=0,y=0;for(var i=0;i<a.cells.length;i++){x+=a.cells[i].x/a.cells.length;y+=a.cells[i].y/a.cells.length;}return {x:x,y:y};}
function _send(t){if(window.gg&&window.gg.send){window.gg.send(t);return true;}return false;}
function _split(){return _send(new Uint8Array([4]).buffer);}
function _feed(){return _send(new Uint8Array([3]).buffer);}
function _eject(m){var p=_mid();if(!p)return;var b=new ArrayBuffer(9),d=new DataView(b);d.setUint8(0,2);d.setInt32(1,p.x|0,true);d.setInt32(5,p.y|0,true);_send(b);}
function _ejectToward(x,y){var b=new ArrayBuffer(9),d=new DataView(b);d.setUint8(0,2);d.setInt32(1,x|0,true);d.setInt32(5,y|0,true);_send(b);}
function _speedMult(){var m=parseFloat(getS().speedMult)||1;return Math.max(1,Math.min(5,m));}
var _lastMove=null;
function _move(x,y){
    try{
        _lastMove={x:x,y:y};
        var m=_speedMult();
        if(m>1){
            var p=_mid();if(p){
                var dx=x-p.x,dy=y-p.y;
                x=p.x+dx*m; y=p.y+dy*m;
            }
        }
        var code="try{window.app&&window.app.unitManager&&window.app.unitManager.activeUnit&&window.app.unitManager.activeUnit.moveTo("+Math.round(x)+","+Math.round(y)+")}catch(e){}";
        var s=document.createElement("script");s.textContent=code;(document.head||document.documentElement).appendChild(s);s.remove();
    }catch(e){}
}
function _beep(){try{var ctx=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();var o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();o.type="square";o.connect(g);g.connect(ctx.destination);o.frequency.value=520;g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15,ctx.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001,ctx.currentTime+0.3);o.start();o.stop(ctx.currentTime+0.3);}catch(e){}}
function _toast(msg){try{var t=document.createElement("div");t.style.cssText="position:fixed;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:2147483500;background:rgba(0,0,0,.85);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #ff1744;font:700 14px Inter,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.5);pointer-events:none";t.textContent=msg;document.body.appendChild(t);setTimeout(function(){t.remove();},1600);}catch(e){}}

// ═════════ RAZZO (RUSH) ═════════
function tRUSH(){
    N.rush=!N.rush;
    N.food=true; // lo stack surge dipende dal feed
    if(N.rush){setStat("zev-rush-stat","ON","#ff1744");_rushLoop();}
    else{setStat("zev-rush-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
var _rusht=null;
function _rushLoop(){
    if(_rusht)clearInterval(_rusht);
    var sg=getS();var bursts=parseInt(sg.rushBursts||"6",10)||6;
    var i=0;
    _rusht=setInterval(function(){
        if(!N.rush)return;
        _split();_eject(1); // split + ejecta a centro (feed sulle masse)
        if(++i>=bursts){clearInterval(_rusht);_rusht=null;tRUSH();} // burst finito → spegni
    },180);
}

// ═════════ WAVE SPLIT ═════════
function tWAVE(){
    N.wave=!N.wave;
    if(N.wave){setStat("zev-wave-stat","ON","#00e5ff");_waveLoop();}
    else{setStat("zev-wave-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
var _wavet=null;
function _waveLoop(){
    if(_wavet)clearInterval(_wavet);
    var sg=getS();var iv=parseInt(sg.waveInterval||"9000",10)||9000;
    _wavet=setInterval(function(){if(N.wave&&_canSplit()){_split();_split();}},iv);
}

// ═════════ ANTI-AFK ═════════
function tAFK(){
    N.antiafk=!N.antiafk;
    if(N.antiafk){setStat("zev-afk-stat","ON","#00e676");_afkLoop();}
    else{setStat("zev-afk-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
var _afkt=null;
function _afkLoop(){
    if(_afkt)clearInterval(_afkt);
    _afkt=setInterval(function(){
        if(!N.antiafk)return;
        _au()&&_feed(); // feed periodico = attività → niente kick AFK
    },45000);
}

// ═════════ VIRUS DODGE ═════════
function tVIRUS(){
    N.virus=!N.virus;
    if(N.virus){setStat("zev-virus-stat","ON","#76ff03");}
    else{setStat("zev-virus-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
// attivo: i virus vicini (distanza < 700) vengono marcati e si evita il feed
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.virus)return;
    try{
        var un=window.app&&window.app.unitManager&&window.app.unitManager.units;
        var v=[];if(un)un.forEach(function(u){if(u.cells){for(var i=0;i<u.cells.length;i++){var m=(u.cells[i].mass||0);if(m>100&&m<160)v.push({x:u.cells[i].x,y:u.cells[i].y});}}});
        var my=_mid();if(!my)return;
        var near=false;
        for(var i=0;i<v.length;i++){var dx=v[i].x-my.x,dy=v[i].y-my.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);if(d<700)near=true;}
        var el=document.getElementById("zev-virus-near");
        if(near){(el||mk('zev-virus-near')).style.display="block";}
        else if(el)el.style.display="none";
    }catch(e){}
},600);

// ═════════ STACK / COMBO FOOD ═════════
function tSTACK(){
    N.stack=!N.stack;
    if(N.stack){setStat("zev-stack-stat","ON","#ffd600");}
    else{setStat("zev-stack-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.stack)return;
    if(!_canSplit())return;
    _split();setTimeout(_split,120);setTimeout(_split,240);
    setTimeout(function(){_feed();_feed();_feed();},400);
},2500);

// ═════════ TOGGLE FOOD (mostra/nasconde cibo) ═════════
function tFOOD(){
    N.food=!N.food;
    // blocca il turbo se disattiviamo il cibo
    if(!N.food)N.turbo=false;
    setStat("zev-food-stat",N.food?"VIS":"HID",N.food?"#4fc3f7":"#ff5252");
    var c=document.getElementById("canvas");
    if(N.food){document.documentElement.style.removeProperty("--zev-food-hide");if(c)c.style.visibility="visible";}
    else{if(c)c.style.visibility="hidden";}
    // nasconde anche gli overlay dei valori (opzionale, lasciato invariato)
}

// ═════════ TURBO FEED ═════════
function tTURBO(){
    // richiede Food VIS (serve il cibo per mangiare)
    if(!N.food){console.warn("[NEO] Turbo richiede Food attivo");return;}
    N.turbo=!N.turbo;
    setStat("zev-turbo-stat",N.turbo?"ON":"OFF",N.turbo?"#ff9100":"#aaa");
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.turbo)return;
    if(!_canSplit())return;
    _split();setTimeout(_feed,60);setTimeout(_feed,140);
},400);

// ═════════ AUTO-BOOST ═════════
function tBOOST(){
    N.boost=!N.boost;
    setStat("zev-boost-stat",N.boost?"ON":"OFF",N.boost?"#ff3d00":"#aaa");
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.boost)return;
    // feed rapido verso massa più vicina
    _feed();_feed();
},350);

// ═════════ SPLIT MASS LIMIT (guardia anti-over-split) ═════════
// I loop automatici di split (wave/stack/rush/collect) eseguono split
// solo se la massa totale è >= del limite impostato. Evita di spezzarsi
// quando si è troppo piccoli.
function _canSplit(){var lim=parseInt((getS().splitMin)||"300",10)||0;return _sum()>=lim;}

// ═════════ NEMICO PIÙ VICINO "MANGIABILE" ═════════
// Ritorna il target più vicino (distanza < hunterRange) con massa
// inferiore alla nostra → possiamo mangiarlo senza morire.
function _nearestEatable(){
    try{
        var a=_au();if(!a||!a.cells||a.cells.length===0)return null;
        var mx=0,my=0,mm=0,i;
        for(i=0;i<a.cells.length;i++){mx+=a.cells[i].x/a.cells.length;my+=a.cells[i].y/a.cells.length;mm+=(a.cells[i].mass||10);}
        var un=window.app.unitManager.units;if(!un)return null;
        var range=parseInt(getS().hunterRange||"3200",10)||3200;
        var best=null;
        un.forEach(function(u){
            if(u===a||!u.cells||u.cells.length===0)return;
            var ux=0,uy=0,um=0,j;
            for(j=0;j<u.cells.length;j++){ux+=u.cells[j].x/u.cells.length;uy+=u.cells[j].y/u.cells.length;um+=(u.cells[j].mass||10);}
            var dx=ux-mx,dy=uy-my,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
            // mangiamo solo chi ha massa < ~90% della nostra
            if(d<range&&um<mm*0.9){if(!best||d<best.d)best={d:d,m:um,x:ux,y:uy,name:(u.cells[0].name||"?").toUpperCase(),mine:mm};}
        });
        return best;
    }catch(e){return null;}
}

// ═════════ TARGET PRIORITARIO (HUNTER) ═════════
function tHUNTER(){
    N.hunter=!N.hunter;
    if(N.hunter){setStat("zev-hunter-stat","ON","#ff4081");N.food=true;}
    else{setStat("zev-hunter-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.hunter)return;
    try{
        var t=_nearestEatable();if(!t)return;
        // muove l'unità attiva verso il target (inietta comando di movimento)
        var code="try{window.app&&window.app.unitManager&&window.app.unitManager.activeUnit&&(window.app.unitManager.activeUnit.moveTo("+Math.round(t.x)+","+Math.round(t.y)+"))}catch(e){}";
        var s=document.createElement("script");s.textContent=code;
        (document.head||document.documentElement).appendChild(s);s.remove();
    }catch(e){}
},150);
// mostra il target nel pannello
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.hunter)return;
    var t=_nearestEatable();var el=document.getElementById("zev-hunter");
    if(t){(el||mk('zev-hunter')).textContent="\ud83c\udff9 "+t.m+" "+t.name+" ["+Math.round(t.d/1000*10)/10+"km]";}
    else if(el)el.textContent="";
},400);

// ═════════ AUTO-TEAM (nutre i compagni) ═════════
function tTEAM(){
    N.team=!N.team;
    if(N.team){setStat("zev-team-stat","ON","#00bcd4");}
    else{setStat("zev-team-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.team)return;
    try{
        var a=_au();if(!a||!a.cells||a.cells.length===0)return;
        var mx=0,my=0,i;for(i=0;i<a.cells.length;i++){mx+=a.cells[i].x/a.cells.length;my+=a.cells[i].y/a.cells.length;}
        var tn=[];
        var taI=document.getElementById("xev-team-a-name"),tbI=document.getElementById("xev-team-b-name");
        if(taI&&taI.value)tn.push(taI.value.toUpperCase());
        if(tbI&&tbI.value)tn.push(tbI.value.toUpperCase());
        if(!tn.length)return;
        var un=window.app.unitManager.units;if(!un)return;
        var friend=null;
        un.forEach(function(u){
            if(u===a||!u.cells||u.cells.length===0)return;
            var nm=(u.cells[0]&&(u.cells[0].name||"")||"").toUpperCase();
            if(tn.indexOf(nm)!==-1){
                var ux=0,uy=0,j;for(j=0;j<u.cells.length;j++){ux+=u.cells[j].x/u.cells.length;uy+=u.cells[j].y/u.cells.length;}
                var dx=ux-mx,dy=uy-my,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
                if(d<1800&&(!friend||d<friend.d))friend={d:d,x:ux,y:uy};
            }
        });
        if(friend&&_sum()>1000){_feed();_feed();} // nutre il compagno se vicino
    }catch(e){}
},500);

// ═════════ AUTO-COLLECT (split+feed per raccolta rapida) ═════════
function tCOLLECT(){
    N.collect=!N.collect;
    if(N.collect){setStat("zev-collect-stat","ON","#aeea00");N.turbo=false;}
    else{setStat("zev-collect-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.collect)return;
    var min=parseInt(getS().collectMin||"200",10)||200;
    if(_sum()<=min||!_canSplit())return;
    _split();setTimeout(_split,90);
    setTimeout(function(){_feed();_feed();},220);
},700);

// ═════════ AUTO-ESCAPE (PRO 5.0) ═════════
// Quando un predatore (molto più grande) si avvicina entro escapeRange,
// l'unità fugge nella direzione opposta e perde massa (eject) per accelerare.
function tESCAPE(){
    N.escape=!N.escape;
    if(N.escape){setStat("zev-escape-stat","ON","#ff9e80");}
    else{setStat("zev-escape-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.escape)return;
    try{
        var a=_au();if(!a||!a.cells||!a.cells.length)return;
        var mx=0,my=0,mm=0,i;
        for(i=0;i<a.cells.length;i++){mx+=a.cells[i].x/a.cells.length;my+=a.cells[i].y/a.cells.length;mm+=(a.cells[i].mass||10);}
        var eMin=parseInt(getS().escapeMin||"300",10)||300;
        if(mm<eMin)return;
        var range=parseInt(getS().escapeRange||"800",10)||800;
        var un=window.app.unitManager.units;if(!un)return;
        var threat=null;
        un.forEach(function(u){
            if(u===a||!u.cells||!u.cells.length)return;
            var ux=0,uy=0,um=0,j;
            for(j=0;j<u.cells.length;j++){ux+=u.cells[j].x/u.cells.length;uy+=u.cells[j].y/u.cells.length;um+=(u.cells[j].mass||10);}
            if(um>mm*1.6){var dx=ux-mx,dy=uy-my,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);if(d<range&&(!threat||d<threat.d))threat={d:d,x:ux,y:uy};}
        });
        if(!threat)return;
        _move(mx+(mx-threat.x),my+(my-threat.y));
        _eject(1);
    }catch(e){}
},120);

// ═════════ AUTO-FARM VELOCE (PRO 5.3) ═════════
// Raccoglie il cibo (virgole) il più in fretta possibile:
//   • scan fino a 2000px, aggiornamento ogni 120ms
//   • punta ANCHE oltre la virgola per soverchiare più cibo
//   • se il cibo è lontano e la massa lo consente: split rapido
//   • quando è addosso al cibo: feed per assorbire più area
//   • SYNERGIA Speed Hack (PRO 5.4): con Speed attivo e x>1, ogni
//     movimento del farm viene moltiplicato e il boost viene
//     ri-applicato ogni 40ms → il bot raccoglie molto più in fretta.
function tFARM(){
    N.farm=!N.farm;
    if(N.farm){setStat("zev-farm-stat","ON","#64dd17");}
    else{setStat("zev-farm-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.farm)return;
    try{
        var a=_au();if(!a||!a.cells||!a.cells.length)return;
        if(N.hunter)return; // evita conflitto con Hunter
        var mx=0,my=0,mm=0,n=a.cells.length,i;
        for(i=0;i<n;i++){mx+=a.cells[i].x/n;my+=a.cells[i].y/n;mm+=(a.cells[i].mass||10);}
        var target=null;
        var fm=window.foodManager||(window.app&&window.app.foodManager);
        if(fm&&fm.food&&fm.food.length){
            for(var j=0;j<fm.food.length;j++){
                var f=fm.food[j];if(!f)continue;
                var fx=f.x||0,fy=f.y||0;
                var dx=fx-mx,dy=fy-my,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
                if(d<2000&&(!target||d<target.d))target={x:fx,y:fy,d:d};
            }
        }
        if(!target)return;
        // anticipazione: punta un po' oltre il cibo per soverchiare più virgole
        var step=Math.min(target.d+40,target.d*1.15);
        var px=mx+((target.x-mx)/target.d)*step;
        var py=my+((target.y-my)/target.d)*step;
        _move(px,py);
        // FARM VELOCE: se il cibo è lontano e abbiamo massa sufficiente,
        // facciamo uno split per raggiungerlo molto più in fretta.
        var smin=parseInt(getS().splitMin||"300",10)||300;
        if(n===1&&mm>=smin&&target.d>500&&_canSplit()){_split();}
        // quando siamo addosso al cibo, feed per assorbire l'area
        else if(target.d<60){_feed();}
    }catch(e){}
},120);

// ═════════ KILL-ALERT (PRO 5.0) ═════════
// Allarme sonoro + toast quando l'unità muore.
function tALERT(){
    N.alert=!N.alert;
    N._alive=false;
    if(N.alert){setStat("zev-alert-stat","ON","#ffab40");}
    else{setStat("zev-alert-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.alert)return;
    try{
        var a=_au();
        var alive=!!(a&&a.cells&&a.cells.length);
        if(alive&&!N._alive){N._alive=true;}
        if(!alive&&N._alive){N._alive=false;_beep();_toast("\ud83d\udc80 Sei morto! Respawn in corso...");}
    }catch(e){}
},500);

// ═════════ ULTRA-SPLIT (PRO 5.0) ═════════
// Burst di 4 split rapidi + feed per coprire tanta area.
function tULTRA(){
    N.ultra=!N.ultra;
    if(N.ultra){setStat("zev-ultra-stat","ON","#40c4ff");}
    else{setStat("zev-ultra-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.ultra)return;
    if(!_canSplit())return;
    _split();setTimeout(_split,70);setTimeout(_split,140);setTimeout(_split,210);
    setTimeout(function(){_feed();_feed();},320);
},500);

// ═════════ AUTO-MERGE (PRO 5.2) ═════════
// Quando hai più celle, sposta la più piccola verso il gruppo (centro di massa)
// e la nutre in direzione della più grande per accelerare la fusione.
function tMERGE(){
    N.merge=!N.merge;
    if(N.merge){setStat("zev-merge-stat","ON","#b388ff");}
    else{setStat("zev-merge-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.merge)return;
    try{
        var a=_au();if(!a||!a.cells||a.cells.length<2)return;
        var n=a.cells.length,i,mx=0,my=0,big=null,small=null;
        for(i=0;i<n;i++){
            var c=a.cells[i];
            mx+=c.x;my+=c.y;
            if(!big||c.mass>big.mass)big=c;
            if(!small||c.mass<small.mass)small=c;
        }
        mx/=n;my/=n;
        _move(small.x+(mx-small.x)*0.5,small.y+(my-small.y)*0.5);
        if(big&&small&&small!==big){
            var dx=big.x-small.x,dy=big.y-small.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
            if(d<700){_send(new Uint8Array([3]).buffer);}
            else{var e=new ArrayBuffer(9),dv=new DataView(e);dv.setUint8(0,2);dv.setInt32(1,(small.x+dx*0.4)|0,true);dv.setInt32(5,(small.y+dy*0.4)|0,true);_send(e);}
        }
    }catch(e){}
},150);

// ═════════ RIM GUARD (PRO 5.2) ═════════
// Tiene l'unità lontana dai bordi del mondo di gioco.
function tRIM(){
    N.rim=!N.rim;
    if(N.rim){setStat("zev-rim-stat","ON","#9ccc65");}
    else{setStat("zev-rim-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.rim)return;
    try{
        var a=_au();if(!a||!a.cells||!a.cells.length)return;
        var mx=0,my=0;for(var i=0;i<a.cells.length;i++){mx+=a.cells[i].x/a.cells.length;my+=a.cells[i].y/a.cells.length;}
        var map=window.gameMap||(window.app&&window.app.gameMap)||null;
        if(!map)return;
        var w=map.width||8000,h=map.height||8000,margin=600;
        var nx=mx,ny=my,need=false;
        if(nx<margin){nx=margin;need=true;}
        if(nx>w-margin){nx=w-margin;need=true;}
        if(ny<margin){ny=margin;need=true;}
        if(ny>h-margin){ny=h-margin;need=true;}
        if(need)_move(nx,ny);
    }catch(e){}
},150);

// ═════════ DANGER RADAR (PRO 5.2) ═════════
// Scappa dal predatore più grande e più vicino (senza condizioni di massa)
// e mostra distanza+nome nel pannello di sorveglianza.
function tDANGER(){
    N.danger=!N.danger;
    if(N.danger){setStat("zev-danger-stat","ON","#ff5252");}
    else{setStat("zev-danger-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.danger)return;
    try{
        var a=_au();if(!a||!a.cells||!a.cells.length)return;
        var mx=0,my=0,mm=0,i;
        for(i=0;i<a.cells.length;i++){mx+=a.cells[i].x/a.cells.length;my+=a.cells[i].y/a.cells.length;mm+=(a.cells[i].mass||10);}
        var range=parseInt(getS().dangerRadius||"1200",10)||1200;
        var un=window.app&&window.app.unitManager&&window.app.unitManager.units;if(!un)return;
        var th=null;
        un.forEach(function(u){
            if(u===a||!u.cells||!u.cells.length)return;
            var ux=0,uy=0,um=0,j;
            for(j=0;j<u.cells.length;j++){ux+=u.cells[j].x/u.cells.length;uy+=u.cells[j].y/u.cells.length;um+=(u.cells[j].mass||10);}
            if(um>mm*1.3){var dx=ux-mx,dy=uy-my,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);if(d<range&&(!th||d<th.d))th={d:d,x:ux,y:uy,name:(u.cells[0]&&u.cells[0].name||"?").toUpperCase()};}
        });
        var el=document.getElementById("zev-danger");
        if(th){
            if(!el)el=document.getElementById("zev-danger-line");
            if(el)el.textContent="\ud83d\udea8 "+Math.round(th.d/1000*10)/10+"km "+th.name;
            _move(mx+(mx-th.x),my+(my-th.y));
        }
        else if(el)el.textContent="";
    }catch(e){}
},120);

// ═════════ MASS HUD (PRO 5.2) — sempre attivo ═════════
setInterval(function(){
    try{
        var a=_au();var mm=0,nc=0;
        if(a&&a.cells&&a.cells.length){nc=a.cells.length;for(var i=0;i<a.cells.length;i++)mm+=(a.cells[i].mass||10);}
        var el=document.getElementById("zev-mass");
        if(el)el.textContent="\ud83d\udcc8 Massa "+Math.round(mm)+" | Celle "+nc;
    }catch(e){}
},400);

// ═════════ SPEED HACK (PRO 5.4) ═════════
// Accelerazione regolabile (x1–x5): estende la destinazione di ogni
// movimento di un fattore "Speed(x)" così la cella percorre più strada
// nello stesso tempo. Combo perfetta con Auto-Farm e Auto-Farm veloce.
function tSPEED(){
    N.speed=!N.speed;
    if(N.speed){setStat("zev-speed-stat","ON  x"+_speedMult().toFixed(1),"#00e5ff");}
    else{setStat("zev-speed-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
// il loop mantiene il boost. In compatibilità con AUTO-FARM:
// ri-spinge lungo l'ultima destinazione scelta (quella del farm)
// molto più spesso del tick del farm (120ms), così la cella continua
// a scattare anche tra un frame di scan e l'altro.
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.speed)return;
    try{
        var m=_speedMult();if(m<=1)return;
        if(_lastMove&&N.farm){
            // Auto-Farm attivo: continui a spingere nel verso del cibo
            _move(_lastMove.x,_lastMove.y);
            _speedStatRefresh();
        }
    }catch(e){}
},40);
function _speedStatRefresh(){if(N.speed){var el=document.getElementById("zev-speed-stat");if(el)el.textContent="ON  x"+_speedMult().toFixed(1);}}

// ═════════ TARGET KILL con VIRUS (PRO 5.4) ═════════
// I bot usano i VIRUS per uccidere il bersaglio selezionato:
//   1. trova il bersaglio (il nome in "KillTarget" se impostato,
//      altrimenti il nemico più vicino non mangiabile)
//   2. trova il virus più comodo rispetto al bersaglio (tra noi e lui)
//   3. si posiziona dietro il virus e ci ejecta massa di continuo
//      -> il virus "scoppia" e scarica una raffica verso il bersaglio.
function tKILLT(){
    N.killt=!N.killt;
    if(N.killt){setStat("zev-killt-stat","ON","#d500f9");}
    else{setStat("zev-killt-stat","OFF","#aaa");}
}
function _findKillTarget(mid){
    try{
        var a=_au();var mm=_sum();
        var un=window.app&&window.app.unitManager&&window.app.unitManager.units;if(!un)return null;
        var kn=String(getS().killTarget||"").toLowerCase().trim();
        var kr=parseInt(getS().killRange||"2500",10)||2500;
        var best=null;
        un.forEach(function(u){
            if(u===a||!u.cells||!u.cells.length)return;
            var ux=0,uy=0,um=0,j;for(j=0;j<u.cells.length;j++){ux+=u.cells[j].x/u.cells.length;uy+=u.cells[j].y/u.cells.length;um+=(u.cells[j].mass||10);}
            var nm="";try{nm=(u.cells[0].name||"").toLowerCase();}catch(e){}
            if(kn&&nm!==kn)return;
            var dx=ux-mid.x,dy=uy-mid.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
            if(d<kr&&(!best||d<best.d))best={x:ux,y:uy,m:um,d:d,name:nm};
        });
        return best;
    }catch(e){return null;}
}
function _findKillVirus(mid,target){
    try{
        var un=window.app&&window.app.unitManager&&window.app.unitManager.units;if(!un)return null;
        var tdx=target.x-mid.x,tdy=target.y-mid.y;
        var td=Math.sqrt(tdx*tdx+tdy*tdy)||1;
        var best=null,bd=1e9;
        un.forEach(function(u){
            if(!u.cells)return;
            for(var i=0;i<u.cells.length;i++){
                var m=u.cells[i].mass||0;
                if(m<100||m>160)continue;
                var vx=u.cells[i].x,vy=u.cells[i].y;
                var dx=vx-mid.x,dy=vy-mid.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
                // il virus deve trovarsi tra noi e il bersaglio (allineato e più vicino a noi che al target)
                if(d>=td)continue;
                var proj=(dx*tdx+dy*tdy)/td; // componente del virus lungo la direzione del target
                if(proj<0)continue;
                if(d<bd){bd=d;best={x:vx,y:vy,d:d};}
            }
        });
        return best;
    }catch(e){return null;}
}
setInterval(function(){
    if(!N.killt)return;
    try{
        var mid=_mid();if(!mid)return;
        var target=_findKillTarget(mid);
        var el=document.getElementById("zev-kill-near");
        if(!target){if(el)el.textContent="";return;}
        if(el)el.textContent="\ud83c\udfaf "+target.name.toUpperCase()+" "+Math.round(target.d/1000*10)/10+"km"+(target.m?" m"+Math.round(target.m):"");
        var virus=_findKillVirus(mid,target);
        if(virus){
            // avviciniamosi dietro il virus rispetto al bersaglio
            var nx=mid.x+(virus.x-mid.x)*0.92, ny=mid.y+(virus.y-mid.y)*0.92;
            var dm=Math.sqrt((virus.x-mid.x)*(virus.x-mid.x)+(virus.y-mid.y)*(virus.y-mid.y));
            if(dm>260)_move(nx,ny);
            else _ejectToward(virus.x+10,virus.y+10); // carichiamo il virus
        }else{
            // niente virus utile: allontaniamoci dal bersaglio per non morire
            _move(mid.x+(mid.x-target.x),mid.y+(mid.y-target.y));
        }
    }catch(e){}
},130);

// ═════════ NOTIFICA NEMICI VICINI ═════════
setInterval(function(){
    try{
        var a=_au();if(!a||!a.cells||!a.cells.length)return;
        var mx=0,my=0,mm=0;for(var i=0;i<a.cells.length;i++){mx+=a.cells[i].x/a.cells.length;my+=a.cells[i].y/a.cells.length;mm+=(a.cells[i].mass||10);}
        var un=window.app.unitManager.units;if(!un)return;
        var near=null;
        un.forEach(function(u){
            if(u===a||!u.cells||u.cells.length===0)return;
            var ux=0,uy=0,um=0,i;
            for(i=0;i<u.cells.length;i++){ux+=u.cells[i].x/u.cells.length;uy+=u.cells[i].y/u.cells.length;um+=(u.cells[i].mass||10);}
            var dx=ux-mx,dy=uy-my,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
            if(d<2500&&um>mm*0.9){if(!near||d<near.d)near={d:d,m:um,name:(u.cells[0].name||"?").toUpperCase()};}
        });
        var el=document.getElementById("zev-near");
        if(near){(el||mk('zev-near')).textContent="\u2694 "+near.m+" "+near.name+" ["+Math.round(near.d/1000*10)/10+"km]";}
        else if(el)el.textContent="";
    }catch(e){}
},800);

// ═════════ CONTATORE VIRALI ═════════
setInterval(function(){
    try{
        var un=window.app&&window.app.unitManager&&window.app.unitManager.units;
        var n=0;if(un)un.forEach(function(u){if(u.cells)for(var i=0;i<u.cells.length;i++){var m=(u.cells[i].mass||0);if(m>100&&m<160)n++;}});
        var p=document.getElementById("zev-vcount");
        if(p)p.textContent="\u2623 Virus: "+n;
    }catch(e){}
},1000);

// ═════════ helper UI ═════════
function mk(id,html){var d=document.createElement("div");d.id=id;d.style.cssText="position:fixed;z-index:99996;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.55);color:#fff;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font:10px monospace;pointer-events:none";if(html)d.innerHTML=html;document.body.appendChild(d);return d;}
function setStat(id,txt,col){var el=document.getElementById(id);if(el){el.textContent=txt;el.style.color=col;}}
function setPanel(){
    // pannello informazioni fisse in basso
    var p=document.getElementById("zev-neo-panel");
    if(!p){p=mk("zev-neo-panel",'<span id="zev-mass"></span><br><span id="zev-near"></span><br><span id="zev-hunter"></span><br><span id="zev-danger" style="color:#ff5252"></span><br><span id="zev-kill-near" style="color:#d500f9"></span><br><span id="zev-vcount"></span><br><span id="zev-virus-near" style="display:none;color:#ff5252">\u26a0 VIRUS VICINO</span>');p.style.cssText="position:fixed;bottom:8px;right:8px;z-index:99996;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.55);color:#fff;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;font:11px monospace;pointer-events:none;text-align:right";}
}

// ═════════ inserimento nel menu overlay ═════════
/* Definisce ogni feature NEO: etichetta, id dello stato,
   funzione toggle, e la chiave impostazioni per il suo tasto.  */
// Mass Boost unificato (spawn 150 + toggle): delega al modulo globale
function tMASSBOOST(){
    if(window.__zevMassBoost&&window.__zevMassBoost.toggle){
        var on=window.__zevMassBoost.is();
        window.__zevMassBoost.toggle();
        var el=document.getElementById("zev-mb-stat");
        if(el){el.textContent=on?"OFF":"ON";el.style.color=on?"#aaa":"#ff9800";}
    }
}
var NEO_FEATURES=[
    {label:"\u26a1 Rush",        stat:"zev-rush-stat",  on:tRUSH,  key:"rushKey"},
    {label:"\ud83c\udf1f Wave Split",stat:"zev-wave-stat",on:tWAVE, key:"waveKey"},
    {label:"\ud83d\udc8b Anti-AFK",   stat:"zev-afk-stat",  on:tAFK,  key:"antiafkKey"},
    {label:"\u2623 Virus Dodge", stat:"zev-virus-stat", on:tVIRUS,key:"virusKey"},
    {label:"\ud83c\udf0a Stack Food", stat:"zev-stack-stat",on:tSTACK,key:"stackKey"},
    {label:"\ud83d\udd25 Turbo Feed", stat:"zev-turbo-stat",on:tTURBO,key:"turboKey"},
    {label:"\ud83d\ude80 Auto Boost", stat:"zev-boost-stat",on:tBOOST,key:"boostKey"},
    {label:"\ud83c\udff9 Hunter",  stat:"zev-hunter-stat",on:tHUNTER,key:"hunterKey"},
    {label:"\ud83e\udd1d Auto-Team",  stat:"zev-team-stat", on:tTEAM, key:"teamKey"},
    {label:"\ud83e\uddf8 Auto-Collect",stat:"zev-collect-stat",on:tCOLLECT,key:"collectKey"},
    {label:"\ud83e\uddca Auto-Escape", stat:"zev-escape-stat",on:tESCAPE,key:"escapeKey"},
    {label:"\ud83c\udf3e Auto-Farm",   stat:"zev-farm-stat", on:tFARM, key:"farmKey"},
    {label:"\ud83d\udd14 Kill-Alert",  stat:"zev-alert-stat",on:tALERT,key:"alertKey"},
    {label:"\ud83c\udf00 Ultra-Split", stat:"zev-ultra-stat",on:tULTRA,key:"ultraKey"},
    {label:"\ud83d\udca0 Auto-Merge",  stat:"zev-merge-stat",on:tMERGE,key:"mergeKey"},
    {label:"\u2b1c Rim Guard",       stat:"zev-rim-stat",  on:tRIM,  key:"rimKey"},
    {label:"\ud83d\udea8 Danger Radar",stat:"zev-danger-stat",on:tDANGER,key:"dangerKey"},
    {label:"\ud83d\udc30 Speed Hack",  stat:"zev-speed-stat", on:tSPEED,key:"speedKey"},
    {label:"\u2623 Kill-Virus",     stat:"zev-killt-stat", on:tKILLT,key:"killtKey"},
    {label:"\ud83c\udf56 Mass Boost",  stat:"zev-mb-stat",  on:tMASSBOOST,key:"mbKey"}
];

// mappa la chiave impostazioni al tasto predefinito corrispondente
function _defaultKeyFor(key){
    var map={
        rushKey:"q",waveKey:"w",antiafkKey:"b",virusKey:"h",stackKey:"c",
        teamKey:"y",hunterKey:"p",collectKey:"u",turboKey:"x",boostKey:"z",
        escapeKey:"k",farmKey:"o",alertKey:"l",ultraKey:"s",
        mergeKey:"g",rimKey:"d",dangerKey:"j",
        speedKey:"2",killtKey:"i",mbKey:"m"
    };
    return map[key]||"";
}

    // crea il sottomenu NEO collassabile
    var box=document.createElement("div");

    head.onclick=function(){var b=document.getElementById("zev-neo-body");if(b){var open=b.style.display!=="none";b.style.display=open?"none":"block";var c=document.getElementById("zev-neo-caret");if(c)c.textContent=open?"\u25b6":"\u25bc";}};

    box.appendChild(body);

        var sg=getS();var cur=(sg[f.key]||_defaultKeyFor(f.key)||"");

        row.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:12px;flex:1">'+f.label+'</span>'+
            '<span id="'+f.stat+'" style="color:#aaa;font-size:11px;min-width:34px;text-align:center">OFF</span>'+
            '<input title="Tasto per attivare/disattivare" data-neo-key="'+f.key+'" data-neo-toggle="'+f.on.name+'" maxlength="1" value="'+(cur||"").toUpperCase()+'" style="width:22px;padding:1px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #ffd54d;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);color:#ffd54d;font-size:11px;text-align:center;letter-spacing:1px"/>';

    ctrl.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:11px;color:#ffd54d">Wave(ms):</span><input id="zev-wave-ms" type="number" min="2000" step="500" value="'+(sg2.waveInterval||9000)+'" style="width:52px;padding:2px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #555;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);color:#ddd;font-size:11px;text-align:center"/><span style="font-size:11px;color:#ffd54d">Burst:</span><input id="zev-rush-n" type="number" min="1" max="20" value="'+(sg2.rushBursts||6)+'" style="width:40px;padding:2px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid step="0.5" value="'+(sg2.speedMult||2)+'" style="width:42px;padding:2px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #555;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);color:#ddd;font-size:11px;text-align:center"/><span style="font-size:11px;color:#ffd54d">KillRange:</span><input id="zev-kill-range" type="number" min="300" step="200" value="'+(sg2.killRange||2500)+'" style="width:52px;padding:2px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #555;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);color:#ddd;font-size:11px;text-align:center"/><span style="width:90px;padding:2px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #555;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);color:#ddd;font-size:11px;text-align:center"/>';
    body.appendChild(ctrl);
    function bindNum(id,key,def){var el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.onchange=function(){var z=getS();z[key]=this.value||def;setS(z);};}
    bindNum("zev-wave-ms","waveInterval","9000");
    bindNum("zev-rush-n","rushBursts","6");
    bindNum("zev-split-min","splitMin","300");
    bindNum("zev-hunt-range","hunterRange","3200");
    bindNum("zev-esc-range","escapeRange","800");
    bindNum("zev-esc-min","escapeMin","300");
    bindNum("zev-danger-range","dangerRadius","1200");
    bindNum("zev-speed","speedMult","2");
    bindNum("zev-kill-range","killRange","2500");

    // campo testo per il nome del bersaglio da uccidere
    var kt=document.getElementById("zev-kill-target");
    if(kt)kt.onchange=function(){var z=getS();z.killTarget=this.value.trim();setS(z);LOG("KillTarget impostato: "+(z.killTarget||"(qualsiasi)"));};

    // Bind tasti: Speed Hack ha bisogno di aver letto la nuova velocità
    var sp=document.getElementById("zev-speed");
    if(sp)sp.addEventListener("change",function(){try{_speedStatRefresh();}catch(e){}});

    // bind per cambiare il tasto di una feature
    var inputs=body.querySelectorAll("[data-neo-key]");
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(inputs,function(inp){
        inp.addEventListener("focus",function(){this.select();});
        inp.addEventListener("input",function(){
            if(this.value.length>1)this.value=this.value.substr(-1);
        });
        inp.addEventListener("change",function(){
            var z=getS();var k=this.getAttribute("data-neo-key");
            var v=this.value.trim().toLowerCase();
            if(!v){this.value="";z[k]="";setS(z);LOG("Tasto rimosso per "+k);return;}
            z[k]=v;setS(z);
            LOG("Tasto \""+v.toUpperCase()+"\" configurato per "+k);
        });
    });

    // inserisce il box nel menu (dopo Player Kill, se presente)
    var pk=m.querySelector("#zev-pk");
    if(pk&&pk.parentNode&&pk.parentNode.parentNode)pk.parentNode.parentNode.insertBefore(box,pk.parentNode.nextSibling);
    else m.appendChild(box);
}

})();

// ═════════ hotkeys NEO (tasti configurabili) ═════════
document.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){
    if(e.target.tagName==="INPUT"||e.target.tagName==="TEXTAREA"||e.target.tagName==="SELECT")return;
    // Food Hide: SHIFT+V (tasto fisso, non configurabile)
    if(e.shiftKey&&(e.key==="V"||e.key==="v")){e.preventDefault();tFOOD();return;}
    if(e.shiftKey)return;
    var sg=getS();
    var k=e.key.toLowerCase();
    // builda una mappa tasto→toggle leggendo le impostazioni
    var map={};
    NEO_FEATURES.forEach(function(f){
        var key=sg[f.key]||_defaultKeyFor(f.key)||"";
        if(key)map[key.toLowerCase()]=f.on;
    });
    if(map[k]){e.preventDefault();map[k]();return;}
    // tasti fissi (non configurabili)
    if(e.key==="F12"){e.preventDefault();tRUSH();return;}
});

/* ═════════ PANNELLO FLOTTANTE NEO (SEMPRE VISIBILE) ═════════
   L'overlay PRO + il client a volte usano altri script che creano
   conflitti di z-index. Questo pannello è indipendente e si appoggia
   a document.body con un pulsante rosso "NEO" in basso a destra.
   Clicca sul pulsante per aprire: contiene tutti i toggle NEO.    */
(function(){
    "use strict";
    var OPEN=false;
    function ensureTop(){
        // Unified v7.1 UI: NEO is rendered only inside #xev-menu.
        return;
        if(!document.documentElement||!document.body){setTimeout(ensureTop,300);return;}
        if(document.getElementById("zev-fixed-panel"))return;
        var wrap=document.createElement("div");
        wrap.id="zev-fixed-panel";
        wrap.style.cssText="position:fixed;bottom:14px;right:14px;z-index:2147483000;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;font-family:Inter,sans-serif";
        var btn=document.createElement("div");
        btn.id="zev-fp-btn";
        btn.style.cssText="background:#ff1744;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.5);user-select:none;letter-spacing:.5px";
        btn.textContent="\ud83c\udfd6 NEO";
        btn.onclick=function(){toggle();};
        var panel=document.createElement("div");
        panel.id="zev-fp-box";
        panel.style.cssText="display:none;width:200px;background:rgba(10,10,12,.92);border:1px solid #ffd54d;border-radius:10px;padding:8px;margin-bottom:6px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.6);color:#fff";
        panel.innerHTML='<div style="font-weight:700;color:#ffd54d;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);padding-bottom:4px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between"><span>\ud83d\udee0\uFE0F NEO</span><span id="zev-fp-close" style="cursor:pointer">&#10005;</span></div>';
        wrap.appendChild(panel);wrap.appendChild(btn);
        // righe feature compatte
        NEO_FEATURES.forEach(function(f){
            var sg=getS();var cur=(sg[f.key]||_defaultKeyFor(f.key)||"");
            var row=document.createElement("div");
            row.style.cssText="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:3px 0;cursor:pointer";
            row.title=(f.label||"")+"  (tasto: "+(cur?cur.toUpperCase():'-')+")";
            row.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:11px;flex:1">'+f.label+'</span><span id="'+f.stat+'" style="color:#aaa;font-size:10px;min-width:30px;text-align:center">OFF</span>';
            row.onclick=function(){f.on();};
            panel.appendChild(row);
        });
        // riga Food Hide
        var fr=document.createElement("div");
        fr.style.cssText="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:3px 0;cursor:pointer";
        fr.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:11px;flex:1">\ud83c\udf6e Food Hide</span><span id="zev-food-stat" style="color:#aaa;font-size:10px;min-width:30px;text-align:center">VIS</span>';
        fr.onclick=tFOOD;
        panel.appendChild(fr);
        // note tasti
        var nt=document.createElement("div");
        nt.style.cssText="margin-top:6px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);padding-top:4px;color:#888;font-size:9px;line-height:1.4";
        nt.innerHTML="Tasti personalizzabili nel menu \u25b8 NEO<br>(Q/W/B/H/C/X/Z/P/Y/U/K/O/L/S/G/D/J + Shift+V cibo)";
        panel.appendChild(nt);
        (document.body||document.documentElement).appendChild(wrap);
        var cl=document.getElementById("zev-fp-close");
        if(cl)cl.onclick=function(){toggle(false);};
    }
    function toggle(force){
        var p=document.getElementById("zev-fp-box");
        if(!p){ensureTop();setTimeout(function(){toggle(force!==false);},100);return;}
        var open=force!==undefined?force:!(p.style.display!=="none");
        p.style.display=open?"block":"none";
        OPEN=open;
    }
    // init + robust: se qualcuno cancella il pannello, lo ricrea
    var started=false;
    function tryStart(){ if(document.body&&!started){started=true;} }
    if(document.body)tryStart();else window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",tryStart);
    window.addEventListener("load",function(){tryStart();});
    // esponi per aprire/chiudere da console se serve
    window.__neoPanel={
        open:function(){var b=document.getElementById("zev-neo-body");if(b){b.style.display="block";var c=document.getElementById("zev-neo-caret");if(c)c.textContent="▼";}},
        close:function(){var b=document.getElementById("zev-neo-body");if(b){b.style.display="none";var c=document.getElementById("zev-neo-caret");if(c)c.textContent="▶";}},
        toggle:function(){var b=document.getElementById("zev-neo-body");if(b){var o=b.style.display!=="none";b.style.display=o?"none":"block";var c=document.getElementById("zev-neo-caret");if(c)c.textContent=o?"▶":"▼";}}
    };
})();

LOG("ZeroExtens PRO v5.4 NEO Addon loaded");

}catch(e){console.error("[ZEV NEO]",e);}
})();
})();


/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ZeroExtens ZE 5.5 — Addon NUOVE FUNZIONI
   ⚡ SNIPE (tasto N)  ·  ☣ TOXIC FARM (tasto 5)
   🔍 AUTO ZOOM (tasto 4)  ·  🛡 VIP GUARD (tasto 7)
   🔔 KILL CONFIRM (toast+suono)  ·  📊 STATUS HUD
   Autonomo: usa solo localStorage "gg-settings" + window.app/gg.
   INCOLLA QUESTO BLOCCO IN FONDO ALLO SCRIPT (dopo l'ultimo })(); )
   Se trova il menu del tuo script (xev-menu) ci aggiunge la sezione
   🔰 ZE 5.5. Se NON lo trova, crea da solo un pulsante flottante in
   basso a sinistra per aprire le funzioni → sempre visibili.
   Solo in gab-immerso (elan popup). Tasti e parametri si cambiano lì.
   Tutte le feature partono SPENTE → nessun cambiamento finchè non le attivi.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function(){
"use strict";
try{

var DEFAULTS={
  snipeKey:"n", toxicKey:"5", zoomKey:"4", vipKey:"7",
  snipeRange:"1400", snipeMin:"400",
  toxicRadius:"600", zoomScale:"1.15", vipNames:"",
  zev55BotCount:"1000", mbMax:"20"
};

function loadS(){
  try{
    var raw=localStorage.getItem("gg-settings");
    var o=raw?JSON.parse(raw):{};
    for(var k in DEFAULTS){ if(o[k]===void 0||o[k]===null) o[k]=DEFAULTS[k]; }
    return o;
  }catch(e){ var d={}; for(var i in DEFAULTS) d[i]=DEFAULTS[i]; return d; }
}
function saveS(o){ try{ localStorage.setItem("gg-settings",JSON.stringify(o)); }catch(e){} }

var F={ snipe:false, toxic:false, zoom:false, vip:false };

/* ── Controllo BOT di riserva (usa lo stesso protocollo dello script base).
   Se gli overlay base (barra XEVBOTS / pannello destro) non si montano,
   da qui puoi comunque avviare/fermare i bot via window.gg. --*/
function z55_slotPack(server,name,amt){
  try{
    var enc=new TextEncoder(), u=enc.encode(String(server||"")), v=enc.encode(String(name||""));
    var b=new ArrayBuffer(1+u.length+1+v.length+1+2), d=new DataView(b), o=0;
    d.setUint8(o++,0);
    for(var i=0;i<u.length;i++) d.setUint8(o++,u[i]); d.setUint8(o++,0);
    for(var i=0;i<v.length;i++) d.setUint8(o++,v[i]); d.setUint8(o++,0);
    d.setUint16(o,amt,true);
    return b;
  }catch(e){ return null; }
}
function z55_ggSend(buf){ try{ if(window.gg&&window.gg.send&&buf){ window.gg.send(buf); return true; } }catch(e){} return false; }
function z55_botNames(){ var s=loadS(), out=[]; for(var i=1;i<=8;i++){ var n=s["botsName"+i]; if(n&&String(n).length) out.push(String(n)); } if(!out.length){ out=["XEVBOTS1","XEVBOTS2","XEVBOTS3","XEVBOTS4","XEVBOTS5","XEVBOTS6","XEVBOTS7","XEVBOTS8"]; } return out; }
function z55_startBotsFromPanel(){
  var s=loadS(), total=Math.max(1,Math.min(500,parseInt(s.zev55BotCount||"10",10)||10));
  var names=z55_botNames(), per=Math.max(1,Math.floor(total/names.length)), rem=total-per*names.length;
  var svr=""; try{ svr=(window.gg&&window.gg.server)||""; }catch(e){}
  names.forEach(function(nm,i){ var c=per+(rem>0?1:0); if(rem>0)rem--; var p=z55_slotPack(svr,nm,c); if(p) z55_ggSend(p); });
  zh55_toast("Zero-Anti-Crash"+total+" Protection ("+names.length+" is Active!)");
}
function z55_stopBotsFromPanel(){ z55_ggSend(new Uint8Array([1]).buffer); zh55_toast("Anti-Crash Disabled"); }

/* ── FIX v5.5.1: WebSocket locale → server bot remoto ──
   Il redirect interno dello script base gestiva solo "wss://localhost" e
   "wss://svr99...", ma il client attacca spesso "ws://localhost/" (ws: senza s)
   o usa porte/percorsi diversi → la connessione fallisce e i bot non arrivano.
   Questo rimpiazzo intercetta OGNI indirizzo locale/xevbots (ws:// o wss://,
   con o senza porta) e lo reindirizza al server remoto. Installato qui
   nell'addon: gira al caricamento, quindi copre le connessioni fatte in seguito
   (spawn bot, keep-alive). Iniettato una sola volta.                      */
(function(){
  var RENDER=localStorage.getItem("zev-render-ws") || "ws://192.168.2.169:80";
  function isLocal(u){
    try{
      var p=new URL(u);
      var h=(p.hostname||"").toLowerCase();
      return h==="localhost"||h==="127.0.0.1"||h==="0.0.0.0"||h==="::1"||String(u).indexOf("xevbots.com")!==-1;
    }catch(e){ return false; }
  }
  if(!window.__z55_wsPatched){
    window.__z55_wsPatched=true;
    try{
      var Orig=window.WebSocket;
      function Patched(u,pr){
        var nu=u;
        try{ if(typeof u==="string"&&isLocal(u)){ try{console.log("%c[ZeroExtens 5.5]","color:#e0ff6b;font-weight:bold","WS redirect → "+RENDER);}catch(e){} nu=RENDER; } }catch(_e){}
        if(pr!==undefined) return new Orig(nu,pr);
        return new Orig(nu);
      }
      window.WebSocket=Patched;
      try{ window.WebSocket.prototype=Orig.prototype; }catch(e){}
      window.WebSocket.CONNECTING=Orig.CONNECTING;
      window.WebSocket.OPEN=Orig.OPEN;
      window.WebSocket.CLOSING=Orig.CLOSING;
      window.WebSocket.CLOSED=Orig.CLOSED;
    }catch(e){}
  }
})();

/* ── FIX v5.5.1: zittisce il crash benigno "profile" del client ──
   Il client Delta carica da remoto e lancia (senza fermare i bot) un
   TypeError "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'profile')"
   ripetuto all'infinito → consolle invasa ed eventuale rallentamento.
   Questo frame intercetta SOLO quel messaggio specifico e lo silenzia,
   senza nascondere altri errori. I bot continuano a funzionare.           */
(function(){
  window.addEventListener("error",function(e){
    try{
      var m=e&&e.message?String(e.message):"";
      if(m.indexOf("reading 'profile'")!==-1||m.indexOf("property 'profile'")!==-1){
        if(e&&e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
      }
    }catch(_){}
  },true);
})();

/* ── helper di gioco (solo letture/safe) ── */
function au(){ try{ return (window.app&&window.app.unitManager&&window.app.unitManager.activeUnit)||null; }catch(e){ return null; } }
function units(){ try{ return (window.app&&window.app.unitManager&&window.app.unitManager.units)||(window.core&&window.core.unitManager&&window.core.unitManager.units)||null; }catch(e){ return null; } }
function unifiedUnits(){
  /* raccoglie unità da più origini per coprire i client senza window.app */
  var list=[];
  try{ var a=au(); if(a&&a.cells&&a.cells.length){ list.push({cells:a.cells, self:true}); } }catch(e){}
  try{
    var UM=window.app&&window.app.unitManager; if(UM&&UM.units) UM.units.forEach(function(u){ if(u) list.push({cells:u.cells||[], self:false}); });
  }catch(e){}
  try{
    var um2=window.core&&window.core.unitManager; if(um2&&um2.units) um2.units.forEach(function(u){ if(u) list.push({cells:u.cells||[], self:false}); });
  }catch(e){}
  return list;
}
function sum(){ var a=au(); if(!a||!a.cells||!a.cells.length) return 0; var m=0; for(var i=0;i<a.cells.length;i++) m+=(a.cells[i].mass||10); return Math.round(m); }
function ncells(){ var a=au(); return (a&&a.cells)?a.cells.length:0; }
function mid(){ var a=au(); if(!a||!a.cells||!a.cells.length) return null; var x=0,y=0,n=a.cells.length; for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ x+=a.cells[i].x/n; y+=a.cells[i].y/n; } return {x:x,y:y}; }
function send(buf){ try{ if(window.gg&&window.gg.send){ window.gg.send(buf); return true; } }catch(e){} return false; }
function splitN(){ try{ return send(new Uint8Array([4]).buffer); }catch(e){} }
function feed(){ try{ return send(new Uint8Array([3]).buffer); }catch(e){} }
function ejectAt(x,y){ try{ var b=new ArrayBuffer(9),d=new DataView(b); d.setUint8(0,2); d.setInt32(1,x|0,true); d.setInt32(5,y|0,true); return send(b); }catch(e){} }
function moveTo(x,y){ try{
  var el=document.createElement("script");
  el.textContent="try{var _a=window.app||window.core;if(_a&&_a.unitManager&&_a.unitManager.activeUnit&&_a.unitManager.activeUnit.moveTo){_a.unitManager.activeUnit.moveTo("+Math.round(x)+","+Math.round(y)+");}}catch(e){}";
  (document.head||document.documentElement).appendChild(el); el.remove();
}catch(e){} }
function dist(ax,ay,bx,by){ var dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay; return Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); }

function vipList(){ var s=loadS(); return String(s.vipNames||"").split(",").map(function(x){ return x.trim().toLowerCase(); }).filter(function(x){ return x; }); }
function isVip(name){ var v=vipList(); var nm=String(name||"").trim().toLowerCase(); for(var i=0;i<v.length;i++){ if(v[i]&&(v[i]===nm||nm.indexOf(v[i])!==-1)) return true; } return false; }

function enemies(){
  var me=au(),out=[];
  unifiedUnits().forEach(function(u){
    if(!u||u.self||!u.cells||!u.cells.length) return;
    var x=0,y=0,m=0,n=u.cells.length;
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ x+=u.cells[i].x/n; y+=u.cells[i].y/n; m+=(u.cells[i].mass||10); }
    var nm=""; try{ nm=(u.cells[0]&&u.cells[0].name)||""; }catch(e){}
    out.push({x:x,y:y,m:Math.round(m),n:n,name:nm});
  });
  return out;
}
function viruses(){
  var out=[];
  unifiedUnits().forEach(function(u){
    if(!u||!u.cells) return;
    for(var i=0;i<u.cells.length;i++){ var mm=u.cells[i].mass||0; if(mm>99&&mm<161) out.push({x:u.cells[i].x,y:u.cells[i].y,r:mm}); }
  });
  return out;
}

function zh55_toast(m){ try{
  var t=document.createElement("div");
  t.style.cssText="position:fixed;top:38%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:2147483500;background:rgba(0,0,0,.88);color:#e0ff6b;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #ffd54d;font:700 14px Inter,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.5);pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap";
  t.textContent=m; document.body.appendChild(t); setTimeout(function(){ t.remove(); },1600);
}catch(e){} }
function zh55_beep(){ try{
  var A=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext; if(!A) return;
  var ctx=new A(), o=ctx.createOscillator(), g=ctx.createGain();
  o.type="square"; o.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
  o.frequency.value=740; g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12,ctx.currentTime);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001,ctx.currentTime+0.25);
  o.start(); o.stop(ctx.currentTime+0.25);
}catch(e){} }

/* ── SNIPE (lunge-kill) ── */
var snipeCd=0, lastTarget=null;
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.snipe) return;
  try{
    var p=mid(); if(!p) return;
    var my=sum(), sg=loadS();
    var min=parseInt(sg.snipeMin||"400",10)||400, rng=parseInt(sg.snipeRange||"1400",10)||1400;
    if(my<min) return;
    var es=enemies(), target=null;
    for(var i=0;i<es.length;i++){
      var e=es[i];
      if(F.vip&&isVip(e.name)) continue;
      if(e.m>my*0.6) continue;
      var d=dist(p.x,p.y,e.x,e.y);
      if(d<rng&&(!target||d<target.d)) target={x:e.x,y:e.y,m:e.m,d:d,name:e.name};
    }
    if(!target){ lastTarget=null; return; }
    moveTo(target.x,target.y);
    var now=Date.now();
    if(target.d<420&&now-snipeCd>650){
      snipeCd=now;
      lastTarget={nm:target.name,m:target.m};
      splitN(); setTimeout(splitN,70);
      setTimeout(function(){ ejectAt(p.x,p.y); feed(); },140);
    }
  }catch(e){}
},90);
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.snipe||!lastTarget) return;
  try{
    var p=mid(); if(!p) return;
    var es=enemies(), found=false;
    for(var i=0;i<es.length;i++){
      if(es[i].name===lastTarget.nm&&dist(p.x,p.y,es[i].x,es[i].y)<2600){ found=true; break; }
    }
    if(!found){
      zh55_toast("🎯 Eliminato: "+String(lastTarget.nm||"?").toUpperCase()+" (+"+lastTarget.m+")");
      zh55_beep(); lastTarget=null;
    }
  }catch(e){}
},500);

/* ── TOXIC FARM (virus → cibo) ── */
var toxicCd=0;
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.toxic) return;
  try{
    var p=mid(); if(!p) return;
    var rng=parseInt(loadS().toxicRadius||"600",10)||600;
    var vs=viruses(), v=null;
    for(var i=0;i<vs.length;i++){ var d=dist(p.x,p.y,vs[i].x,vs[i].y); if(d<rng&&(!v||d<v.d)) v={x:vs[i].x,y:vs[i].y,d:d}; }
    if(!v) return;
    var now=Date.now();
    if(v.d<70){ if(now-toxicCd>400){ toxicCd=now; feed(); } }
    else{
      moveTo(v.x,v.y);
      if(now-toxicCd>180){ toxicCd=now; ejectAt(v.x,v.y); }
    }
  }catch(e){}
},110);

/* ── AUTO ZOOM (camera fit, best-effort / safe) ── */
function zoomTick(){
  var a=au(); if(!a||!a.cells||!a.cells.length) return;
  var d=0; for(var i=0;i<a.cells.length;i++){ var c=a.cells[i]; var r=c.radius||(c.mass?Math.sqrt(c.mass*100):40); if(r>d) d=r; }
  var s=parseFloat(loadS().zoomScale||"1.15")||1.15;
  try{
    var cam=window.gameViewport||window.camera||(window.app&&window.app.camera)||(window.gg&&window.gg.camera)||null;
    if(!cam) return;
    if(typeof cam.setZoom==="function"){ cam.setZoom(s); return; }
    if(typeof cam.setScale==="function"){ cam.setScale(s); return; }
    if(cam.zoom!==undefined){ cam.zoom=s; return; }
  }catch(e){}
}
setInterval(function(){ if(F.zoom) zoomTick(); },250);

/* ── STATUS HUD ── */
function hudEl(){
  var el=document.getElementById("zev55-hud");
  if(!el){
    el=document.createElement("div"); el.id="zev55-hud";
    el.style.cssText="position:fixed;top:8px;left:8px;z-index:2147483400;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);color:#fff;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:6px;font:10px monospace;pointer-events:none;line-height:1.5;white-space:pre";
    (document.body||document.documentElement).appendChild(el);
  }
  return el;
}
var hudTick=null;

function setStat(id,on){ var el=document.getElementById(id); if(el){ el.textContent=on?"ON":"OFF"; el.style.color=on?"#e0ff6b":"#aaa"; } }
function toggle(id){
  F[id]=!F[id];
  setStat("zev55-"+id,F[id]);
  hudTick&&hudTick();
  zh55_toast(id.toUpperCase()+" "+(F[id]?"ON":"OFF"));
}

/* ── GENERATORE UI: costruisce righe + campi + ascoltatori.
   Ritorna un elemento condiviso riusabile sia dentro xev-menu sia nel popup flottante. ── */
function buildConfigUI(){
  var sg=loadS();

  var body=document.createElement("div");
  body.style.cssText="display:block;margin-top:4px;padding:4px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:6px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.25)";

  var ROWS=[
    {label:"⚡ Snipe",     key:"snipeKey", set:"snipe", def:"n"},
    {label:"☣️ Toxic Farm",key:"toxicKey", set:"toxic", def:"5"},
    {label:"🔍 Auto Zoom", key:"zoomKey",  set:"zoom",  def:"4"},
    {label:"🛡️ VIP Guard", key:"vipKey",   set:"vip",   def:"7"}
  ];
  ROWS.forEach(function(r){
    var cur=(sg[r.key]||r.def||"");
    var row=document.createElement("div");
    row.style.cssText="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:3px;cursor:pointer";
    row.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:12px;flex:1">'+r.label+'</span>'+
      '<span id="zev55-'+r.set+'" style="color:#aaa;font-size:11px;min-width:32px;text-align:center">OFF</span>'+
      '<input data-z55-key="'+r.key+'" data-z55-set="'+r.set+'" maxlength="1" value="'+(cur||"").toUpperCase()+'" style="width:20px;padding:1px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #e0ff6b;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#e0ff6b;font-size:11px;text-align:center"/>';
    row.onclick=function(ev){ if(ev&&ev.target&&ev.target.tagName==="INPUT") return; toggle(r.set); };
    body.appendChild(row);
  });

  var c=document.createElement("div");
  c.style.cssText="margin-top:6px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);padding-top:5px;display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center";
  c.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:11px;color:#e0ff6b">SnipeR:</span><input data-z55-num="snipeRange" type="number" min="400" step="100" value="'+(sg.snipeRange||1400)+'" style="width:52px;padding:2px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #555;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#ddd;font-size:11px;text-align:center"/>'+
  '<span style="font-size:11px;color:#e0ff6b">Min:</span><input data-z55-num="snipeMin" type="number" min="100" step="50" value="'+(sg.snipeMin||400)+'" style="width:48px;padding:2px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #555;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#ddd;font-size:11px;text-align:center"/>'+
  '<span style="font-size:11px;color:#e0ff6b">Zoom:</span><input data-z55-num="zoomScale" type="number" min="1" max="3" step="0.05" value="'+(sg.zoomScale||1.15)+'" style="width:52px;padding:2px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #555;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#ddd;font-size:11px;text-align:center"/>'+
  '<span style="font-size:11px;color:#e0ff6b">MBmax:</span><input data-z55-num="mbMax" type="number" min="1" max="200" step="5" value="'+(sg.mbMax||20)+'" title="Limite eject del Mass Boost" style="width:48px;padding:2px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #555;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#ddd;font-size:11px;text-align:center"/>';
  body.appendChild(c);

  var vd=document.createElement("div"); vd.style.cssText="margin-top:5px;display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center";
  vd.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:11px;color:#e0ff6b;min-width:74px">VIP nomi:</span><input id="zev55-vip" type="text" value="'+(sg.vipNames||"")+'" placeholder="nome1,nome2" style="flex:1;padding:3px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #555;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#ddd;font-size:11px"/>';
  body.appendChild(vd);

  var vpin=document.getElementById("zev55-vip");
  if(vpin) vpin.addEventListener("change",function(){ var s=loadS(); s.vipNames=this.value.trim(); saveS(s); hudTick&&hudTick(); });

  Array.prototype.forEach.call(body.querySelectorAll("[data-z55-key]"),function(el){
    el.addEventListener("focus",function(){ this.select(); });
    el.addEventListener("input",function(){ if(this.value.length>1) this.value=this.value.substr(-1); });
    el.addEventListener("change",function(){
      var s=loadS(), k=el.getAttribute("data-z55-key"), v=this.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      if(!v){ this.value=""; } else s[k]=v;
      saveS(s);
    });
  });
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(body.querySelectorAll("[data-z55-num]"),function(el){
    el.addEventListener("change",function(){
      var s=loadS(), k=el.getAttribute("data-z55-num"), v=parseFloat(el.value);
      if(isNaN(v)) v=DEFAULTS[k];
      s[k]=String(v); saveS(s);
    });
  });

  /* ── Controllo BOT di riserva ── */
  var bc=document.createElement("div");
  bc.style.cssText="margin-top:5px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);padding-top:5px";
  bc.innerHTML='<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-bottom:3px"><span style="font-size:11px;color:#ff8a3d;font-weight:700;flex:1">\u2699\ufe0f Bot (riserva)</span><span id="zev55-botstat" style="font-size:10px;color:#888">per nessun menu base</span></div>'+
    '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-bottom:4px"><span style="font-size:11px;color:#e0ff6b;min-width:52px">N\u00b0 bot</span><input id="zev55-botcount" type="number" min="1" max="500" value="'+(loadS().zev55BotCount||10)+'" style="width:56px;padding:2px 4px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #555;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#ddd;font-size:11px;text-align:center"/></div>'+
    '<div style="display:flex;gap:4px"><button type="button" data-z55-bot="start" style="flex:1;background:#28a745;color:#fff;border:none;padding:5px;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:11px">\u25b6 START</button><button type="button" data-z55-bot="stop" style="flex:1;background:#dc3545;color:#fff;border:none;padding:5px;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:11px">\u25a0 STOP</button></div>';
  body.appendChild(bc);

  var bct=G2("zev55-botcount");
  if(bct) bct.addEventListener("change",function(){ var s=loadS(); s.zev55BotCount=String(Math.max(1,Math.min(500,parseInt(this.value,10)||10))); saveS(s); });
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(body.querySelectorAll("[data-z55-bot]"),function(el){
    el.addEventListener("click",function(){
      var act=el.getAttribute("data-z55-bot");
      if(act==="start") z55_startBotsFromPanel(); else z55_stopBotsFromPanel();
    });
  });

  return body;
}

function G2(id){ try{ return document.getElementById(id); }catch(e){ return null; } }

/* crea la sezione dentro il menu esistente (xev-menu) */
function mountIntoMenu(m){
  if(document.getElementById("zev55-box")) return;
  var sg=loadS();
  var box=document.createElement("div"); box.id="zev55-box";
  box.style.cssText="margin-top:6px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);padding-top:6px";
  var head=document.createElement("div");
  head.style.cssText="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;padding:2px 0";
  head.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#e0ff6b">🔰 ZE 5.5</span><span id="zev55-caret" style="color:#e0ff6b;font-size:11px">▼</span><span style="font-size:10px;color:#888;flex:1;text-align:right">tap per chiudere</span>';
  head.onclick=function(){
    var b=document.getElementById("zev55-menu-body"); if(!b) return;
    var open=b.style.display!=="none";
    b.style.display=open?"none":"block";
    var c=document.getElementById("zev55-caret"); if(c) c.textContent=open?"▶":"▼";
  };
  box.appendChild(head);
  var wb=document.createElement("div"); wb.id="zev55-menu-body";
  wb.style.display="block"; wb.appendChild(buildConfigUI());
  box.appendChild(wb);
  m.appendChild(box);
}

/* crea un pannello flottante autonomo (quando non c'e' il menu del tuo script) */
function ensureFab(){
  // Unified v7.1 UI: ZE 5.5 is rendered only inside #xev-menu.
  return;
  if(document.getElementById("zev55-fab")) return;
  if(!document.body) return;

  var fab=document.createElement("div"); fab.id="zev55-fab";
  fab.style.cssText="position:fixed;left:8px;bottom:8px;z-index:2147483450;background:rgba(8,10,14,.9);color:#e0ff6b;border:1px solid #e0ff6b;border-radius:10px;padding:7px 12px;font:700 12px Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.5);user-select:none";
  fab.textContent="🔰 ZE 5.5";
  fab.title="Funzioni 5.5 (l'addon non ha trovato il menu principale)";
  document.body.appendChild(fab);

  var pop=document.createElement("div"); pop.id="zev55-pop";
  pop.style.cssText="display:none;position:fixed;left:8px;bottom:44px;width:232px;max-height:72vh;overflow:auto;z-index:2147483450;background:rgba(9,11,15,.94);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:12px;padding:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.6)";
  var head=document.createElement("div");
  head.style.cssText="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding-bottom:6px";
  head.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#e0ff6b;flex:1">🔰 ZE 5.5</span><span class="zev55-x" style="cursor:pointer;color:#e0ff6b;font-size:13px">✖</span>';
  pop.appendChild(head);
  pop.appendChild(buildConfigUI());
  document.body.appendChild(pop);

  fab.onclick=function(){ pop.style.display=pop.style.display==="none"?"block":"none"; };
  var x=pop.querySelector(".zev55-x");
  if(x){ x.onclick=function(){ pop.style.display="none"; }; }
}

/* hudTick reale */
hudTick=function(){
  if(!document.body) return;
  var on=F.snipe?"ON":"OFF", tx=F.toxic?"ON":"OFF", zm=F.zoom?"ON":"OFF";
  var vl=F.vip?vipList():[];
  var el=hudEl(); el.style.display="block";
  el.textContent="🔰 ZE55 | Snipe "+on+" Toxic "+tx+" Zoom "+zm+"\n"+
    "VIP: "+(F.vip?(vl.length?vl.join(","):"—"):"OFF")+"\n"+
    "Massa "+sum()+" ("+ncells()+"c)";
};
setInterval(hudTick,500);

document.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){
  if(e.target&&(e.target.tagName==="INPUT"||e.target.tagName==="TEXTAREA"||e.target.tagName==="SELECT")) return;
  if(e.shiftKey||e.ctrlKey||e.altKey||e.metaKey) return;
  var s=loadS(), k=e.key.toLowerCase(), map={};
  map[s.snipeKey||"n"]="snipe";
  map[s.toxicKey||"5"]="toxic";
  map[s.zoomKey ||"4"]="zoom";
  map[s.vipKey  ||"7"]="vip";
  if(map[k]){ e.preventDefault(); toggle(map[k]); }
  else hudTick&&hudTick();
});

/* ── avvio: il pulsante giallo 🔰 ZE 5.5 compare SEMPRE.
   L'addon non si aggancia piu' al menu base (xev-menu): usa sempre il
   proprio pannello flottante, cosi' e' affidabile e non sparisce. --*/
(function(){
  var iv=setInterval(function(){
    var m=document.getElementById("xev-menu");
    if(document.body && m){
      clearInterval(iv);
      if(!document.getElementById("zev55-box")) mountIntoMenu(m);
      hudTick&&hudTick();
    }
  },300);
  setTimeout(function(){
    var m=document.getElementById("xev-menu");
    if(m && !document.getElementById("zev55-box")) mountIntoMenu(m);
    hudTick&&hudTick();
  },4000);
})();

/* ── v7.1 Unified Menu watchdog ── */
(function(){
  var tries=0;
  var iv=setInterval(function(){
    try{
      var m=document.getElementById("xev-menu");
      if(!m){if(++tries>40)clearInterval(iv);return;}
      if(!document.getElementById("zev55-box"))mountIntoMenu(m);
      if(!document.getElementById("zev-neo-box")&&typeof _buildNeoMenu==="function")_buildNeoMenu(m);
      if(++tries>40)clearInterval(iv);
    }catch(e){if(++tries>40)clearInterval(iv);}
  },500);
})();

setTimeout(function(){

  }catch(e){}
  try{
    var st=document.getElementById("zev55-botstat");
