  }catch(e){}
},3000);

console.info("%c[ZeroExtens 5.5]","color:#e0ff6b;font-weight:bold","Addon nuovi funzione caricato: Snipe / Toxic / Zoom / VIP / HUD");

}catch(e){ console.error("[ZEV 5.5]",e); }
})();

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ZeroExtens ZE 6.x — Addon NUOVE FUNZIONI
   🧭 MINIMAP (tasto 8)    ·  🎯 AUTO-AIM predittivo (tasto 9)
   🛑 ALL-STOP d'emergenza (tasto 0)  ·  🛡️ ANTI-CRASH (tasto 6)
   Autonomo: usa localStorage "gg-settings" + window.app/gg.
   Aggiunge un pulsante flottante "🔰 ZE 6.0" in basso al centro.
   Nuove funzioni:
     • Minimap: radar in tempo reale (te, nemici, virus, cibo) nel raggio scelto.
     • Auto-Aim: caccia il nemico mangiabile più vicino ANTICIPANDO il suo
       movimento (predizione della velocità) → colpi più precisi, split quando
       è alla giusta distanza.
     • All-Stop: congela TUTTI i bot (blocca ogni invio comandi a window.gg),
       utile per non farsi "cuocere" o uscire puliti. Premi di nuovo per riprendere.
     • Anti-Crash: rileva un attacco di flood/packet-spam (FPS crollano) e
       blocca i crash e l'auto-reload della pagina, riprendendo a fine attacco.
   ── V6.0.1: predizione usa la velocità reale (2 campioni) e lead time adattivo.
   ── V6.0.2: All-Stop ripristina correttamente gg.send e nasconde la minimap.
   ── V6.2:  Mass Boost con limite eject personalizzabile + guardia anti-refresh.
   ── V6.3:  +🌊 X-Burst (A) +🚨 Auto-Escape (E) +🎯 Kill-Lock (R).
   ── V6.4:  +🧲 Auto-Gather (F) +💠 Precision-Split (T) +🛡️ Safe-Merge (V).
   ── V6.5:  +💪 Mass Alerts (1) +💀 Death Alert (3) +🔇 Mute (Shift+M)
             +🛰️ Border Guard (Shift+B) +🌪️ Spiral Farm (Shift+F) +🛡️ Protect Small (Shift+P).
   ── V6.6:  +⏱️ Auto-Restart (Shift+R) con attesa regolabile (campo Restart).
   ── V7.0:  +23 nuove funzioni → 40 totali: 🧲 Vacuum · 🛡️ Virus Shield
             · 💥 Virus Pop · 🤝 Feed Team · ⚖️ Feed Smallest · 🏠 Safe Center
            · 🧗 Edge Hunter · 🔫 Finish Kill · 💤 Pacifist · 🚶 Wander Farm
            · 🎁 Rich Farm · 🌱 Growth Boost · 🏹 Ambush · ⚡ Escape Burst
            · 🖥️/📏/👁️ HUD (FPS/Size/Threat) · 🗺️ Grid Patrol · 🔗 Force Merge
            · 🎯 Zone Control · 😋 Picky Eater · 🧍 Solo Mode · 🛡️ Anti-Virus.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function(){
"use strict";
try{

var DEFAULTS={
  mmKey:"8", aimKey:"9", panicKey:"0", acKey:"6",
  xbKey:"a", aeKey:"e", klKey:"r",
  agKey:"f", psKey:"t", smKey:"v",
  maKey:"1", daKey:"3", muKey:"shift+m", bgKey:"shift+b", spKey:"shift+f", prKey:"shift+p",
  rsKey:"shift+r", rsDelay:"5",
  vcKey:"g", vsKey:"x", vpKey:"y", ftKey:"w", fsKey:"b", scKey:"c", ehKey:"h", fkKey:"k",
  pcKey:"p", wfKey:"q", rfKey:"d", gbKey:"s", amKey:"m", ebKey:"o",
  fhKey:"2", shKey:"4", thKey:"5", gpKey:"i", fmKey:"n", zcKey:"u", peKey:"j", soKey:"l", avKey:"z",
  mmRange:"3000", aimRange:"2600", aimMin:"500",
  acFps:"12", escDist:"700"
};

function loadS(){
  try{
    var raw=localStorage.getItem("gg-settings");
    var o=raw?JSON.parse(raw):{};
    for(var k in DEFAULTS){ if(o[k]===void 0||o[k]===null) o[k]=DEFAULTS[k]; }
    return o;
  }catch(e){ var d={}; for(var i in DEFAULTS) d[i]=DEFAULTS[i]; return d; }
}
function saveS(o){ try{ localStorage.setItem("gg-settings",JSON.stringify(o)); }catch(e){} }

var F={ all:false, minimap:false, aim:false, ac:false, burst:false, esc:false, lock:false, gather:false, split:false, merge:false, mass:false, death:false, mute:false, border:false, spiral:false, protect:false, restart:false, vc:false, vs:false, vp:false, ft:false, fs:false, sc:false, eh:false, fk:false, pc:false, wf:false, rf:false, gb:false, am:false, eb:false, fh:false, sh:false, th:false, gp:false, fm:false, zc:false, pe:false, so:false, av:false };
var __zevPanic=!!window.__zevPanic;
window.__zevPanic=__zevPanic;
window.__zevAntiCrash=false;
window.__zevMute=false;

/* ── helper di gioco (solo letture/safe, stesse API degli altri addon) ── */
function au(){ try{ return (window.app&&window.app.unitManager&&window.app.unitManager.activeUnit)||null; }catch(e){ return null; } }
function selfCells(){ try{ var a=au(); return (a&&a.cells)?a.cells:[]; }catch(e){ return []; } }
function allUnits(){
  var list=[];
  try{
    var a=au(); if(a&&a.cells&&a.cells.length){ list.push({cells:a.cells,self:true}); }
  }catch(e){}
  try{ var UM=window.app&&window.app.unitManager; if(UM&&UM.units) UM.units.forEach(function(u){ if(u) list.push({cells:u.cells||[],self:false}); }); }catch(e){}
  try{ var um2=window.core&&window.core.unitManager; if(um2&&um2.units) um2.units.forEach(function(u){ if(u) list.push({cells:u.cells||[],self:false}); }); }catch(e){}
  return list;
}
function midSelf(){ var c=selfCells(),n=c.length; if(!n) return null; var x=0,y=0; for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ x+=c[i].x/n; y+=c[i].y/n; } return {x:x,y:y}; }
function sumMass(){ var c=selfCells(),m=0; for(var i=0;i<c.length;i++) m+=(c[i].mass||10); return m; }
function enemies(){
  var me=au(),out=[];
  allUnits().forEach(function(u){
    if(!u||u.self||!u.cells||!u.cells.length) return;
    var x=0,y=0,m=0,n=u.cells.length;
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ x+=u.cells[i].x/n; y+=u.cells[i].y/n; m+=(u.cells[i].mass||10); }
    var nm=""; try{ nm=(u.cells[0]&&u.cells[0].name)||""; }catch(e){}
    out.push({x:x,y:y,m:Math.round(m),name:nm});
  });
  return out;
}
function viruses(){
  var out=[];
  allUnits().forEach(function(u){
    if(!u||!u.cells) return;
    for(var i=0;i<u.cells.length;i++){ var mm=u.cells[i].mass||0; if(mm>99&&mm<161) out.push({x:u.cells[i].x,y:u.cells[i].y,m:mm}); }
  });
  return out;
}
function foods(){
  var out=[];
  try{
    var fm=window.foodManager||(window.app&&window.app.foodManager)||(window.core&&window.core.foodManager)||null;
    if(fm&&fm.food&&fm.food.length){ for(var i=0;i<fm.food.length;i++){ var f=fm.food[i]; if(f) out.push({x:f.x||0,y:f.y||0}); } }
  }catch(e){}
  return out;
}
function send(buf){ try{ if(window.gg&&window.gg.send){ window.gg.send(buf); return true; } }catch(e){} return false; }
function splitN(){ try{ return send(new Uint8Array([4]).buffer); }catch(e){} }
function feed(){ try{ return send(new Uint8Array([3]).buffer); }catch(e){} }
function moveTo(x,y){ try{
  var el=document.createElement("script");
  el.textContent="try{var _a=window.app||window.core;if(_a&&_a.unitManager&&_a.unitManager.activeUnit&&_a.unitManager.activeUnit.moveTo){_a.unitManager.activeUnit.moveTo("+Math.round(x)+","+Math.round(y)+");}}catch(e){}";
  (document.head||document.documentElement).appendChild(el); el.remove();
}catch(e){} }

/* ── toast / suono ── */
function zh60_toast(m){ try{
  var t=document.createElement("div");
  t.style.cssText="position:fixed;top:62%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:2147483501;background:rgba(0,0,0,.88);color:#ffd54d;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #ffd54d;font:700 14px Inter,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.5);pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap";
  t.textContent=m; document.body.appendChild(t); setTimeout(function(){ t.remove(); },1400);
}catch(e){} }
var __ctx60=null;
function zh60_ctx(){ if(__ctx60) return __ctx60; try{ var A=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext; if(A) __ctx60=new A(); }catch(e){} return __ctx60||null; }
function zh60_beep(){ try{
  if(window.__zevMute) return;
  var ctx=zh60_ctx(); if(!ctx) return;
  var o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();
  o.type="square"; o.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
  o.frequency.value=660; g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1,ctx.currentTime);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001,ctx.currentTime+0.2);
  o.start(); o.stop(ctx.currentTime+0.2);
}catch(e){} }
function zh60_danger(show, ang){
  try{
    var d=document.getElementById("zev60-danger");
    if(!d){
      d=document.createElement("div"); d.id="zev60-danger";
      d.style.cssText="position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483498;pointer-events:none;display:none;";
      d.innerHTML='<div style="position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(255,23,68,0) 38%, rgba(255,23,68,.6) 100%);animation:zev60-pulse .7s ease-in-out infinite;"></div>'+
        '<div style="position:absolute;left:50%;top:7%;transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;font:900 24px Inter,sans-serif;color:#ff1744;text-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,23,68,.95);letter-spacing:1px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);padding:6px 16px;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid #ff1744">⚠️ PERICOLO</div>'+
        '<div id="zev60-danger-arrow" style="position:absolute;left:50%;top:62%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:72px;height:72px;font-size:64px;line-height:72px;text-align:center;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(255,23,68,1))">⬆️</div>';
      (document.body||document.documentElement).appendChild(d);
      if(!document.getElementById("zev60-keyframes")){
        var st=document.createElement("style"); st.id="zev60-keyframes";
        st.textContent="@keyframes zev60-pulse{0%{opacity:.3}50%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:.3}}";
        (document.head||document.documentElement).appendChild(st);
      }
    }
    if(show){
      d.style.display="block";
      var ar=d.querySelector("#zev60-danger-arrow");
      if(ar&&typeof ang==="number"){ ar.style.transform="translate(-50%,-50%) rotate("+((ang*180/Math.PI)+90)+"deg)"; }
    }else{ d.style.display="none"; }
  }catch(e){}
}

/* ── 🧭 MINIMAP ── */
function ensureMap(){
  var c=document.getElementById("zev60-map");
  if(!c){
    c=document.createElement("canvas");
    c.id="zev60-map";
    c.width=180; c.height=180;
    c.style.cssText="position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:58px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:2147483001;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(8,10,14,.62);pointer-events:none";
    (document.body||document.documentElement).appendChild(c);
  }
  return c;
}
function toggleMap(){
  F.minimap=!F.minimap;
  if(F.minimap&&!__zevPanic){ ensureMap(); var m=document.getElementById("zev60-map"); if(m) m.style.display="block"; zh60_toast("🧭 Minimap ON"); }
  else{ var m=document.getElementById("zev60-map"); if(m) m.style.display="none"; zh60_toast("🧭 Minimap OFF"); }
  setStat("zev60-mm",F.minimap&&!__zevPanic);
}
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.minimap||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var c=ensureMap(); var ctx=c.getContext("2d");
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);
    var me=midSelf();
    if(!me){ ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.4)"; ctx.fillRect(0,0,20,20); return; }
    var range=parseFloat(loadS().mmRange||"3000",10)||3000;
    var S=c.width/(2*range);
    function px(x){ return c.width/2+(x-me.x)*S; }
    function py(y){ return c.height/2+(y-me.y)*S; }
    var i,dx,dy;
    // cibo
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(130,220,130,.75)";
    var fs=foods();
    for(i=0;i<fs.length;i++){ dx=fs[i].x-me.x; dy=fs[i].y-me.y; if(dx*dx+dy*dy>range*range) continue; ctx.fillRect(px(fs[i].x)-1,py(fs[i].y)-1,2,2); }
    // virus
    ctx.fillStyle="#8dff4a";
    var vs=viruses();
    for(i=0;i<vs.length;i++){ dx=vs[i].x-me.x; dy=vs[i].y-me.y; if(dx*dx+dy*dy>range*range) continue; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px(vs[i].x),py(vs[i].y),3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
    // nemici
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,60,60,.9)";
    var es=enemies();
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){ dx=es[i].x-me.x; dy=es[i].y-me.y; if(dx*dx+dy*dy>range*range) continue; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px(es[i].x),py(es[i].y),Math.max(2,Math.sqrt(es[i].m)/4),0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
    // te
    ctx.fillStyle="#ffffff";
    var sc=selfCells();
    for(i=0;i<sc.length;i++){ dx=sc[i].x-me.x; dy=sc[i].y-me.y; if(dx*dx+dy*dy>range*range) continue; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px(sc[i].x),py(sc[i].y),Math.max(2,Math.sqrt(sc[i].mass||10)/4),0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
    ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.25)"; ctx.strokeRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);
  }catch(e){}
},120);

/* ── 🎯 AUTO-AIM (predittivo) ── */
var aimPrev=null, aimTime=0, aimCd=0;
function toggleAim(){
  F.aim=!F.aim;
  if(F.aim){ aimPrev=null; zh60_toast("🎯 Auto-Aim ON"); }
  else zh60_toast("🎯 Auto-Aim OFF");
  setStat("zev60-aim",F.aim&&!__zevPanic);
}
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.aim||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=au(); if(!me||!me.cells||!me.cells.length) return;
    var mx=0,my=0,mm=0,n=me.cells.length,i;
    for(i=0;i<n;i++){ mx+=me.cells[i].x/n; my+=me.cells[i].y/n; mm+=(me.cells[i].mass||10); }
    var sg=loadS();
    var rng=parseFloat(sg.aimRange||"2600",10)||2600;
    var mn=parseFloat(sg.aimMin||"500",10)||500;
    if(mm<mn) return;
    var es=enemies(),best=null;
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){
      if(es[i].m>mm*0.85) continue;
      var dx=es[i].x-mx,dy=es[i].y-my,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
      if(d<rng&&(!best||d<best.d)) best=es[i];
    }
    if(!best){ aimPrev=null; return; }
    var now=Date.now(),vx=0,vy=0;
    if(aimPrev&&aimPrev.key===best.name&&aimTime>0&&(now-aimTime)>0&&(now-aimTime)<1000){
      var dt=(now-aimTime)/1000;
      vx=(best.x-aimPrev.x)/dt; vy=(best.y-aimPrev.y)/dt;
    }
    var lead=Math.min(0.5,Math.max(0.12,best.d/4000));
    moveTo(best.x+vx*lead,best.y+vy*lead);
    aimPrev={key:best.name,x:best.x,y:best.y}; aimTime=now;
    if(best.d<350&&n<=16&&mm>=200&&now-aimCd>600){ aimCd=now; splitN(); setTimeout(splitN,80); }
  }catch(e){}
},120);

/* ── 🛑 ALL-STOP (congela tutti i bot) ── */
var __origSend=null;
function togglePanic(){
  __zevPanic=!__zevPanic; window.__zevPanic=__zevPanic;
  if(__zevPanic){
    try{ if(window.gg&&window.gg.send&&!__origSend) __origSend=window.gg.send; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(window.gg) window.gg.send=function(){ return false; }; }catch(e){}
    var m=document.getElementById("zev60-map"); if(m) m.style.display="none";
    zh60_danger(false);
    zh60_toast("🛑 ALL-STOP — bot congelati");
  }else{
    try{ if(window.gg&&__origSend) window.gg.send=__origSend; }catch(e){}
    __origSend=null;
    if(F.minimap){ var m=document.getElementById("zev60-map"); if(m) m.style.display="block"; }
    zh60_toast("▶ Ripristinato");
  }
  setStat("zev60-panic",__zevPanic);
  setStat("zev60-aim",F.aim&&!__zevPanic);
  setStat("zev60-mm",F.minimap&&!__zevPanic);
}

/* ── 🛡️ ANTI-CRASH (anti-flood / anti-crash del client) ── */
// Se qualcuno tenta un attacco di flood/packet-spam verso il server della
// partita (un "crash exploit"), il client si intasa, gli FPS crollano e la
// pagina tende a congelarsi o ricaricarsi. Con la funzione attiva:
//   • rileva l'anomalia (FPS < soglia per alcuni secondi);
//   • blocca all'istante i flussi aggressivi del bot;
//   • congela i tentativi di reload automatico durante l'attacco;
//   • riprende da solo quando il carico torna normale.
// NOTA: uno script nel browser NON può fermare un DDoS a livello di rete:
// questa funzione protegge il TUO client dal crash e dall'auto-reload.
var __acFrames=0,__acLast=Date.now(),__acFps=60,__acLow=0,__acMode=false;
var __acBlockUntil=0,__acOrigReload=null;
var __acRaf=window.requestAnimationFrame;
if(typeof __acRaf==="function"){
  window.requestAnimationFrame=function(cb){
    return __acRaf.call(window,function(t){
      __acFrames++;
      var n=Date.now(),dt=n-__acLast;
      if(dt>=1000){ __acFps=__acFrames*1000/dt; __acFrames=0; __acLast=n; }
      try{ cb(t); }catch(e){}
    });
  };
}
function __acStat(txt,col){ var h=document.getElementById("zev60-ac"); if(h){ h.textContent=txt; h.style.color=col; } }
function __acGuardReload(){
  try{
    if(__acOrigReload) return;
    var loc=window.location;
    __acOrigReload=loc.reload?loc.reload.bind(loc):null;
    if(!__acOrigReload) return;
    Object.defineProperty(loc,"reload",{configurable:true,writable:true,value:function(){
      if(__acMode&&Date.now()<__acBlockUntil) return; // blocca il reload durante l'attacco
      return __acOrigReload.apply(loc,arguments);
    }});
  }catch(e){}
}
function enterCrash(){
  if(__acMode) return;
  __acMode=true; window.__zevAntiCrash=true; __acBlockUntil=Date.now()+3000;
  try{ if(window.__zevMassBoost&&window.__zevMassBoost.off) window.__zevMassBoost.off(); }catch(e){}
  __acGuardReload();
  __acStat("BLOCK","#ff1744");
  zh60_toast("⚠️ ATTACK DETECTED — anti-crash attivo");
}
function exitCrash(){
  if(!__acMode) return;
  __acMode=false; window.__zevAntiCrash=false;
  if(F.ac) setStat("zev60-ac",true); else setStat("zev60-ac",false);
}
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.ac){ __acLow=0; return; }
  __acGuardReload();
  var thr=parseInt(loadS().acFps||"12",10)||12;
  if(__acFps<thr){ __acLow++; } else if(__acLow>0){ __acLow--; }
  if(__acLow>=3) enterCrash();
  else if(__acMode&&__acFps>=30) exitCrash();
},800);
function toggleAc(){
  F.ac=!F.ac;
  if(!F.ac) exitCrash();
  if(F.ac) setStat("zev60-ac",true); else setStat("zev60-ac",false);
  zh60_toast(F.ac?"🛡️ Anti-Crash ON":"🛡️ Anti-Crash OFF");
}

/* ── 🌊 X-BURST (key A): raffica split+feed verso il nemico mangiabile ── */
var xbCd=0,xfCd=0;
function toggleBurst(){
  F.burst=!F.burst;
  zh60_toast(F.burst?"🌊 X-Burst ON":"🌊 X-Burst OFF");
  setStat("zev60-burst",F.burst&&!__zevPanic);
}
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.burst||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=au(); if(!me||!me.cells||!me.cells.length) return;
    var mx=0,my=0,mm=0,n=me.cells.length,i;
    for(i=0;i<n;i++){ mx+=me.cells[i].x/n; my+=me.cells[i].y/n; mm+=(me.cells[i].mass||10); }
    if(mm<200||n>=16) return; // niente raffiche a massa bassa o già divisi
    var rng=2200,best=null;
    var es=enemies();
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){
      if(es[i].m>mm*0.9) continue;
      var dx=es[i].x-mx,dy=es[i].y-my,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
      if(d<rng&&(!best||d<best.d)) best=es[i];
    }
    if(!best) return;
    moveTo(best.x,best.y);
    var now=Date.now();
    if(now-xbCd>150){ xbCd=now; splitN(); } // split
    if(now-xfCd>90&&best.d<600){ xfCd=now; feed(); } // divora subito la preda spaccata
  }catch(e){}
},130);

/* ── 🚨 AUTO-ESCAPE (key E): fugge dal nemico più grande e pericoloso ── */
var escCd=0;
function toggleEsc(){
  F.esc=!F.esc;
  if(!F.esc) zh60_danger(false);
  zh60_toast(F.esc?"🚨 Auto-Escape ON":"🚨 Auto-Escape OFF");
  setStat("zev60-esc",F.esc&&!__zevPanic);
}
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.esc||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=au(); if(!me||!me.cells||!me.cells.length) return;
    var mx=0,my=0,mm=0,n=me.cells.length,i;
    for(i=0;i<n;i++){ mx+=me.cells[i].x/n; my+=me.cells[i].y/n; mm+=(me.cells[i].mass||10); }
    var dist=parseFloat(loadS().escDist||"700",10)||700;
    var threat=null,td=0;
    var es=enemies();
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){
      if(es[i].m<mm*1.1) continue; // solo nemici più grandi di te
      var dx=es[i].x-mx,dy=es[i].y-my,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
      if(d<dist&&(!threat||d<td)){ threat=es[i]; td=d; }
    }
    if(!threat){ zh60_danger(false); return; }
    var ang=Math.atan2(my-threat.y,mx-threat.x);
    moveTo(mx+Math.cos(ang)*600,my+Math.sin(ang)*600);
    var now=Date.now();
    if(td<350&&now-escCd>250){ escCd=now; splitN(); } // split per scappare più veloce
    zh60_danger(true,Math.atan2(threat.y-my,threat.x-mx)); // freccia verso il nemico
  }catch(e){}
},120);

/* ── 🎯 KILL-LOCK (key R): aggancia e schiaccia il bersaglio più grosso ── */
function toggleLock(){
  F.lock=!F.lock;
  zh60_toast(F.lock?"🎯 Kill-Lock ON":"🎯 Kill-Lock OFF");
  setStat("zev60-lock",F.lock&&!__zevPanic);
}
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.lock||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=au(); if(!me||!me.cells||!me.cells.length) return;
    var mx=0,my=0,mm=0,n=me.cells.length,i;
    for(i=0;i<n;i++){ mx+=me.cells[i].x/n; my+=me.cells[i].y/n; mm+=(me.cells[i].mass||10); }
    var rng=3400,best=null,bd=0;
    var es=enemies();
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){
      if(es[i].m>mm*1.15) continue; // non agganciare un nemico più grosso di te (ti mangerebbe)
      var dx=es[i].x-mx,dy=es[i].y-my,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
      if(d<rng&&(!best||es[i].m>bd)){ best=es[i]; bd=es[i].m; }
    }
    if(!best) return;
    moveTo(best.x,best.y); // punta SEMPRE al centro del bersaglio
  }catch(e){}
},100);

/* ── 🧲 AUTO-GATHER (key F): magnet che raccoglie il cibo vicino ── */
function toggleGather(){
  F.gather=!F.gather;
  zh60_toast(F.gather?"🧲 Auto-Gather ON":"🧲 Auto-Gather OFF");
  setStat("zev60-gather",F.gather&&!__zevPanic);
}
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.gather||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=au(); if(!me||!me.cells||!me.cells.length) return;
    var mx=0,my=0,n=me.cells.length,i;
    for(i=0;i<n;i++){ mx+=me.cells[i].x/n; my+=me.cells[i].y/n; }
    // se c'è un nemico grosso vicino, non ci fermiamo a raccogliere
    var es=enemies(),thr=false;
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){ var dx=es[i].x-mx,dy=es[i].y-my,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); if(es[i].m>1200&&d<600){ thr=true; break; } }
    if(thr) return;
    var rng=700,fs=foods(),sx=0,sy=0,cnt=0;
    for(i=0;i<fs.length;i++){ var dx=fs[i].x-mx,dy=fs[i].y-my; if(dx*dx+dy*dy<rng*rng){ sx+=fs[i].x; sy+=fs[i].y; cnt++; } }
    if(!cnt) return;
    moveTo(sx/cnt,sy/cnt); // verso il baricentro del cibo
  }catch(e){}
},150);

/* ── 💠 PRECISION-SPLIT (key T): split mirato con anticipo sul nemico che scappa ── */
var psPrev=null,psTime=0,psCd=0;
function togglePsplit(){
  F.split=!F.split;
  if(F.split) psPrev=null;
  zh60_toast(F.split?"💠 Precision-Split ON":"💠 Precision-Split OFF");
  setStat("zev60-split",F.split&&!__zevPanic);
}
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.split||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=au(); if(!me||!me.cells||!me.cells.length) return;
    var mx=0,my=0,mm=0,n=me.cells.length,i;
    for(i=0;i<n;i++){ mx+=me.cells[i].x/n; my+=me.cells[i].y/n; mm+=(me.cells[i].mass||10); }
    if(mm<300||n>=8) return;
    var rng=2400,best=null;
    var es=enemies();
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){
      if(es[i].m>mm*0.7) continue; // deve essere mangiabile
      var dx=es[i].x-mx,dy=es[i].y-my,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
      if(d>500&&d<rng&&(!best||d<best.d)) best=es[i];
    }
    if(!best){ psPrev=null; return; }
    var now=Date.now(),vx=0,vy=0;
    if(psPrev&&psPrev.key===best.name&&psTime>0&&(now-psTime)>0&&(now-psTime)<1000){
      var dt=(now-psTime)/1000; vx=(best.x-psPrev.x)/dt; vy=(best.y-psPrev.y)/dt;
    }
    var lead=Math.min(0.45,Math.max(0.15,best.d/3500));
    moveTo(best.x+vx*lead,best.y+vy*lead);
    psPrev={key:best.name,x:best.x,y:best.y}; psTime=now;
    // un solo split ben calibrato quando il bersaglio è in fuga alla distanza giusta
    if(best.d>380&&best.d<950&&now-psCd>900){ psCd=now; splitN(); }
  }catch(e){}
},130);

/* ── 🛡️ SAFE-MERGE (key V): unisci le tue celle solo quando è sicuro ── */
function toggleMerge(){
  F.merge=!F.merge;
  zh60_toast(F.merge?"🛡️ Safe-Merge ON":"🛡️ Safe-Merge OFF");
  setStat("zev60-merge",F.merge&&!__zevPanic);
}
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.merge||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=au(); if(!me||!me.cells||!me.cells.length) return;
    var n=me.cells.length; if(n<=1) return;
    var mx=0,my=0,mm=0,i;
    for(i=0;i<n;i++){ mx+=me.cells[i].x/n; my+=me.cells[i].y/n; mm+=(me.cells[i].mass||10); }
    // solo se non ci sono nemici pericolosi nei dintorni (così non rischi)
    var es=enemies(),safe=true;
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){ var dx=es[i].x-mx,dy=es[i].y-my,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); if(es[i].m>mm*0.6&&d<1600){ safe=false; break; } }
    if(!safe) return;
    // unisci: sposta tutte le celle verso la più grande
    var big=-1,bm=0;
    for(i=0;i<n;i++){ var cm=me.cells[i].mass||10; if(cm>bm){ bm=cm; big=i; } }
    if(big<0) return;
    moveTo(me.cells[big].x,me.cells[big].y);
  }catch(e){}
},180);

    var si=0,sm=1e9,i;

    var small=c[si];
    var es=enemies(),thr=null,td=0;
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){ var dx=es[i].x-small.x,dy=es[i].y-small.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); if(es[i].m>sm*1.3&&d<900&&(!thr||d<td)){ thr=es[i]; td=d; } }
    if(!thr) return;

  }catch(e){}

/* ── ⏱️ AUTO-RESTART (key Shift+R): dopo la morte rientra in partita dopo N secondi.
   NON ricarica la pagina: aspetta il ritardo impostato e clicca Play/respawn. ── */
var rsState=0, rsTimer=null; // 0=attesa gioco, 1=nel gioco, 2=conto alla rovescia
function toggleRestart(){
  F.restart=!F.restart;
  if(!F.restart){ rsState=0; if(rsTimer){ clearTimeout(rsTimer); rsTimer=null; } }
  zh60_toast(F.restart?"⏱️ Auto-Restart ON":"⏱️ Auto-Restart OFF");
  setStat("zev60-restart",F.restart&&!__zevPanic);
}
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.restart||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var m=sumMass();
    if(rsState===0){ if(m>=40) rsState=1; } // in partita appena hai celle reali (soglia uguale alla morte)
    else if(rsState===1){
      if(m<40){
        rsState=2;
        var sec=parseInt(loadS().rsDelay||"5",10)||5;
        zh60_toast("💀 Morte — restart tra "+sec+"s");
        if(rsTimer) clearTimeout(rsTimer);
        rsTimer=setTimeout(function(){ rsState=0; doRestart(); },sec*1000);
      }
    }
  }catch(e){}
},600);
function doRestart(){
  try{
    var sel="button, input[type=button], input[type=submit]";
    var labels=["play","gioca","jugar","respawn","rejoin","restart","repair","ok"];
    var els=document.querySelectorAll(sel),done=false;
    for(var i=0;i<els.length&&!done;i++){
      var el=els[i];
      var t=(el.innerText||el.value||el.textContent||"").trim().toLowerCase();
      var vis=el.offsetWidth>0&&el.offsetHeight>0;
      if(!vis||!t) continue;
      for(var j=0;j<labels.length;j++){
        if(t.indexOf(labels[j])===0){ try{ el.click(); done=true; zh60_toast("⏱️ Rientrato in partita"); }catch(e){} break; }
      }
    }
    if(!done) zh60_toast("⏱️ Restart: premi Play per rientrare");
  }catch(e){}
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ZE 7.0 — 23 NUOVE FUNZIONI (più le 17 di ZE 6 → 40 totali)
   ── 🧲 Vacuum · 🛡️ Virus Shield · 💥 Virus Pop · 🤝 Feed Team
       ⚖️ Feed Smallest · 🏠 Safe Center · 🧗 Edge Hunter · 🔫 Finish Kill
       💤 Pacifist · 🚶 Wander Farm · 🎁 Rich Farm · 🌱 Growth Boost
       🏹 Ambush · ⚡ Escape Burst · 🖥️ FPS HUD · 📏 Size HUD · 👁️ Threat HUD
       🗺️ Grid Patrol · 🔗 Force Merge · 🎯 Zone Control · 😋 Picky Eater
       🧍 Solo Mode · 🛡️ Anti-Virus
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function selfName(){ try{ var c=selfCells(); return (c.length&&c[0].name)||""; }catch(e){ return ""; } }
function nearestVirus(x,y,r){ var vs=viruses(),bn=null,bd=r||1e9,i; for(i=0;i<vs.length;i++){ var dx=vs[i].x-x,dy=vs[i].y-y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); if(d<bd){ bd=d; bn=vs[i]; } } return bn; }

/* 1. 🧲 VACUUM (g): forte calamita verso tutto il cibo nel raggio */
function toggleVc(){ F.vc=!F.vc; zh60_toast(F.vc?"🧲 Vacuum ON":"🧲 Vacuum OFF"); setStat("zev60-vc",F.vc&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.vc||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=midSelf(); if(!me) return;
    var mm=sumMass();
    var es=enemies(),i,danger=false;
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){ var dx=es[i].x-me.x,dy=es[i].y-me.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); if(es[i].m>mm*1.2&&d<600){ danger=true; break; } }
    if(danger) return;
    var fs=foods(),sx=0,sy=0,n=0,rng=1200;
    for(i=0;i<fs.length;i++){ var dx=fs[i].x-me.x,dy=fs[i].y-me.y; if(dx*dx+dy*dy<rng*rng){ sx+=fs[i].x; sy+=fs[i].y; n++; } }
    if(n) moveTo(sx/n,sy/n);
  }catch(e){}
},150);

/* 2. 🛡️ VIRUS SHIELD (x): nasconditi dietro il virus più vicino dal predatore */
function toggleVs(){ F.vs=!F.vs; zh60_toast(F.vs?"🛡️ Virus Shield ON":"🛡️ Virus Shield OFF"); setStat("zev60-vs",F.vs&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.vs||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=midSelf(); if(!me) return;
    var mm=sumMass(),i,pred=null,pd=0;
    var es=enemies();
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){ var dx=es[i].x-me.x,dy=es[i].y-me.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); if(es[i].m>mm*1.25&&d<1800&&(!pred||d<pd)){ pred=es[i]; pd=d; } }
    if(!pred) return;
    var v=nearestVirus(me.x,me.y,900); if(!v) return;
    var ax=pred.x-v.x,ay=pred.y-v.y,al=Math.sqrt(ax*ax+ay*ay); if(!al) return;
    moveTo(v.x+ax/al*200,v.y+ay/al*200); // dietro il virus, lontano dal predatore
  }catch(e){}
},160);

/* 3. 💥 VIRUS POP (y): alimenta il virus vicino al nemico per farlo esplodere */
var vpCd=0;
function toggleVp(){ F.vp=!F.vp; zh60_toast(F.vp?"💥 Virus Pop ON":"💥 Virus Pop OFF"); setStat("zev60-vp",F.vp&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.vp||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=midSelf(); if(!me) return;
    var mm=sumMass(); if(mm<800) return;
    var es=enemies(),i,tar=null;
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){
      if(es[i].m>mm*0.9) continue;
      var v=nearestVirus(es[i].x,es[i].y,650);
      if(v){ tar=v; break; }
    }
    if(!tar) return;
    moveTo(tar.x,tar.y);
    var now=Date.now();
    if(now-vpCd>220){ vpCd=now; feed(); } // spara pellet nel virus
  }catch(e){}
},160);

/* 4. 🤝 FEED TEAM (w): aiuta il compagno di squadra (stesso nome) più grande */
var ftCd=0;
function toggleFt(){ F.ft=!F.ft; zh60_toast(F.ft?"🤝 Feed Team ON":"🤝 Feed Team OFF"); setStat("zev60-ft",F.ft&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.ft||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=midSelf(); if(!me) return;
    var nm=selfName(),es=enemies(),i,best=null;
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){
      if(es[i].name!==nm) continue;
      var dx=es[i].x-me.x,dy=es[i].y-me.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
      if(d<900&&(!best||es[i].m>best.m)) best=es[i];
    }
    if(!best) return;
    moveTo(best.x,best.y);
    var now=Date.now();
    if(now-ftCd>200){ ftCd=now; feed(); }
  }catch(e){}
},160);

/* 5. ⚖️ FEED SMALLEST (b): la cella più grossa nutre quella più piccola */
var fsCd=0;
function toggleFs(){ F.fs=!F.fs; zh60_toast(F.fs?"⚖️ Feed Smallest ON":"⚖️ Feed Smallest OFF"); setStat("zev60-fs",F.fs&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.fs||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var c=selfCells(); if(c.length<2) return;
    var bi=0,bm=0,si=0,sm=1e9,i;
    for(i=0;i<c.length;i++){ var cm=c[i].mass||10; if(cm>bm){ bm=cm; bi=i; } if(cm<sm){ sm=cm; si=i; } }
    if(sm>bm*0.6) return;
    moveTo(c[si].x,c[si].y);
    var now=Date.now();
    if(now-fsCd>250){ fsCd=now; feed(); }
  }catch(e){}
},170);

/* 7. 🧗 EDGE HUNTER (h): caccia i nemici mangiabili vicini al bordo (non scappano) */
function toggleEh(){ F.eh=!F.eh; zh60_toast(F.eh?"🧗 Edge Hunter ON":"🧗 Edge Hunter OFF"); setStat("zev60-eh",F.eh&&!__zevPanic); }

    var mm=sumMass(),es=enemies(),i,best=null,bd=0;
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){
      if(es[i].m>mm*0.9) continue;
      var dx=es[i].x-me.x,dy=es[i].y-me.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
      var db=Math.sqrt(es[i].x*es[i].x+es[i].y*es[i].y); // distanza dal centro
      if(db>7000&&d<3000&&(!best||db>bd)){ best=es[i]; bd=db; }
    }
    if(best) moveTo(best.x,best.y);
  }catch(e){}
},170);

/* 8. 🔫 FINISH KILL (k): split finale per chiudere la preda vicinissima */

function toggleFk(){ F.fk=!F.fk; zh60_toast(F.fk?"🔫 Finish Kill ON":"🔫 Finish Kill OFF"); setStat("zev60-fk",F.fk&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){

    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){
      if(es[i].m>mm*0.8) continue;
      var dx=es[i].x-me.x,dy=es[i].y-me.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
      if(d<240&&n<=16){ var now=Date.now(); if(now-fkCd>400){ fkCd=now; splitN(); } break; }
    }
  }catch(e){}
},140);

function togglePc(){ F.pc=!F.pc; zh60_toast(F.pc?"💤 Pacifist ON":"💤 Pacifist OFF"); setStat("zev60-pc",F.pc&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.pc||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=midSelf(); if(!me) return;
    var mm=sumMass(),es=enemies(),i,pred=null,pd=0;
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){ var dx=es[i].x-me.x,dy=es[i].y-me.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); if(es[i].m>mm*1.1&&d<1400&&(!pred||d<pd)){ pred=es[i]; pd=d; } }
    if(pred){ var a=Math.atan2(me.y-pred.y,me.x-pred.x); moveTo(me.x+Math.cos(a)*700,me.y+Math.sin(a)*700); return; }
    var fs=foods(),sx=0,sy=0,n=0;
    for(i=0;i<fs.length;i++){ var dx=fs[i].x-me.x,dy=fs[i].y-me.y; if(dx*dx+dy*dy<800*800){ sx+=fs[i].x; sy+=fs[i].y; n++; } }
    if(n) moveTo(sx/n,sy/n);
  }catch(e){}
},160);

/* 10. 🚶 WANDER FARM (q): esplora random per trovare zone ricche di cibo */
var wfPt=null,wfCd=0;
function toggleWf(){ F.wf=!F.wf; if(F.wf){ wfPt=null; } zh60_toast(F.wf?"🚶 Wander Farm ON":"🚶 Wander Farm OFF"); setStat("zev60-wf",F.wf&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.wf||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=midSelf(); if(!me) return;
    var mm=sumMass(),es=enemies(),i,pred=null,pd=0;
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){ var dx=es[i].x-me.x,dy=es[i].y-me.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); if(es[i].m>mm*1.2&&d<1200&&(!pred||d<pd)){ pred=es[i]; pd=d; } }
    if(pred){ var a=Math.atan2(me.y-pred.y,me.x-pred.x); moveTo(me.x+Math.cos(a)*900,me.y+Math.sin(a)*900); wfPt=null; return; }
    var now=Date.now();

  }catch(e){}

function toggleRf(){ F.rf=!F.rf; zh60_toast(F.rf?"🎁 Rich Farm ON":"🎁 Rich Farm OFF"); setStat("zev60-rf",F.rf&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.rf||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;

      var dx=fs[i].x-me.x,dy=fs[i].y-me.y; if(dx*dx+dy*dy>1800*1800) continue;
      var cnt=0,j;
      for(j=0;j<fs.length;j++){ var ddx=fs[j].x-fs[i].x,ddy=fs[j].y-fs[i].y; if(ddx*ddx+ddy*ddy<500*500) cnt++; }
      if(cnt>bc){ bc=cnt; bx=fs[i]; }
    }
    if(bx) moveTo(bx.x,bx.y);
  }catch(e){}
},300);

function toggleGb(){ F.gb=!F.gb; zh60_toast(F.gb?"🌱 Growth Boost ON":"🌱 Growth Boost OFF"); setStat("zev60-gb",F.gb&&!__zevPanic); }

    if(!safe) return;
    var fs=foods(),sx=0,sy=0,n=0;

    if(n) moveTo(sx/n,sy/n);

var amCd=0;
function toggleAm(){ F.am=!F.am; zh60_toast(F.am?"🏹 Ambush ON":"🏹 Ambush OFF"); setStat("zev60-am",F.am&&!__zevPanic); }

    moveTo(spot.x,spot.y);

  }catch(e){}

var ebCd=0;
function toggleEb(){ F.eb=!F.eb; zh60_toast(F.eb?"⚡ Escape Burst ON":"⚡ Escape Burst OFF"); setStat("zev60-eb",F.eb&&!__zevPanic); }

    var mm=sumMass(),es=enemies(),i,pred=null,pd=0;

    if(!pred) return;

/* 15-17. HUD (FPS / Size / Threat) — un riquadro in alto a destra */
var __hFrames=0,__hLast=Date.now(),__hFps=60;
(function(){ function loop(){ __hFrames++; var n=Date.now(),dt=n-__hLast; if(dt>=500){ __hFps=Math.round(__hFrames*1000/dt); __hFrames=0; __hLast=n; } try{ requestAnimationFrame(loop); }catch(e){} } try{ requestAnimationFrame(loop); }catch(e){} })();
function zh70_hud(lines){
  try{
    var h=document.getElementById("zev70-hud");
    if(!h){ h=document.createElement("div"); h.id="zev70-hud"; h.style.cssText="position:fixed;top:8px;right:8px;z-index:2147483496;pointer-events:none;font:10px Inter,sans-serif;color:#cfd6e4;background:rgba(8,10,14,.6);padding:5px 8px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);white-space:pre-line;text-align:right;line-height:1.5"; (document.body||document.documentElement).appendChild(h); }
    h.style.display=(lines&&lines.length)?"block":"none";
    if(lines&&lines.length) h.textContent=lines.join("\n");
  }catch(e){}
}
function toggleFh(){ F.fh=!F.fh; zh60_toast(F.fh?"🖥️ FPS HUD ON":"🖥️ FPS HUD OFF"); setStat("zev60-fh",F.fh&&!__zevPanic); }
function toggleSh(){ F.sh=!F.sh; zh60_toast(F.sh?"📏 Size HUD ON":"📏 Size HUD OFF"); setStat("zev60-sh",F.sh&&!__zevPanic); }
function toggleTh(){ F.th=!F.th; zh60_toast(F.th?"👁️ Threat HUD ON":"👁️ Threat HUD OFF"); setStat("zev60-th",F.th&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  var lines=[];
  if(F.fh) lines.push("🖥️ "+__hFps+" FPS");
  if(F.sh||F.th){
    var m=sumMass(),c=selfCells().length,me=midSelf();
    if(F.sh) lines.push("📏 "+Math.round(m)+" | "+c+" celle");
    if(F.th&&me){
      var mm=sumMass(),es=enemies(),i,cnt=0,nd=1e9;
      for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){ if(es[i].m>mm*1.1){ var dx=es[i].x-me.x,dy=es[i].y-me.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); if(d<1500){ cnt++; if(d<nd) nd=d; } } }
      lines.push("👁️ pericoli: "+cnt+(cnt?" | "+Math.round(nd):""));
    }
  }
  zh70_hud(lines);
},400);

/* 18. 🗺️ GRID PATROL (i): pattuglia una griglia 3x3 per coprire la mappa */
var gpIdx=0,gpCd=0;
var gpGrid=[];
(function(){ var s=7000; for(var i=0;i<3;i++){ for(var j=0;j<3;j++){ gpGrid.push({x:(i-1)*s,y:(j-1)*s}); } } })();
function toggleGp(){ F.gp=!F.gp; if(F.gp){ gpIdx=0; gpCd=0; } zh60_toast(F.gp?"🗺️ Grid Patrol ON":"🗺️ Grid Patrol OFF"); setStat("zev60-gp",F.gp&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.gp||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=midSelf(); if(!me) return;
    var p=gpGrid[gpIdx%gpGrid.length],dx=p.x-me.x,dy=p.y-me.y;
    moveTo(p.x,p.y);
    var now=Date.now();
    if((dx*dx+dy*dy)<160000||now-gpCd>4500){ if(now-gpCd>4500){ gpCd=now; } gpIdx++; }
  }catch(e){}
},250);

/* 19. 🔗 FORCE MERGE (n): riunisci le celle sempre (anche sotto pericolo) */
function toggleFm(){ F.fm=!F.fm; zh60_toast(F.fm?"🔗 Force Merge ON":"🔗 Force Merge OFF"); setStat("zev60-fm",F.fm&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.fm||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var c=selfCells(),n=c.length,i; if(n<=1) return;
    var big=-1,bm=0;
    for(i=0;i<n;i++){ var cm=c[i].mass||10; if(cm>bm){ bm=cm; big=i; } }
    if(big<0) return;
    moveTo(c[big].x,c[big].y);
  }catch(e){}
},180);

/* 20. 🎯 ZONE CONTROL (u): tieni le tue celle dentro la zona centrale */
function toggleZc(){ F.zc=!F.zc; zh60_toast(F.zc?"🎯 Zone Control ON":"🎯 Zone Control OFF"); setStat("zev60-zc",F.zc&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.zc||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=midSelf(); if(!me) return;
    if(Math.abs(me.x)>5000||Math.abs(me.y)>5000) moveTo(me.x*0.8,me.y*0.8);
  }catch(e){}
},200);

/* 21. 😋 PICKY EATER (j): caccia solo prede di un certo peso (ignora i pezzettini) */
function togglePe(){ F.pe=!F.pe; zh60_toast(F.pe?"😋 Picky Eater ON":"😋 Picky Eater OFF"); setStat("zev60-pe",F.pe&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.pe||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=midSelf(); if(!me) return;
    var mm=sumMass(),es=enemies(),i,best=null,bd=0;
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){
      if(es[i].m<150||es[i].m>mm*0.9) continue; // niente prede minuscole
      var dx=es[i].x-me.x,dy=es[i].y-me.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
      if(d<2600&&(!best||es[i].m>bd)){ best=es[i]; bd=es[i].m; }
    }
    if(best) moveTo(best.x,best.y);
  }catch(e){}
},170);

/* 22. 🧍 SOLO MODE (l): evita i compagni, gioca da solista (non li nutri) */
function toggleSo(){ F.so=!F.so; zh60_toast(F.so?"🧍 Solo Mode ON":"🧍 Solo Mode OFF"); setStat("zev60-so",F.so&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.so||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=midSelf(); if(!me) return;
    var nm=selfName(),es=enemies(),i,mate=null,md=0;
    for(i=0;i<es.length;i++){
      if(es[i].name!==nm) continue;
      var dx=es[i].x-me.x,dy=es[i].y-me.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
      if(d<700&&(!mate||d<md)){ mate=es[i]; md=d; }
    }
    if(mate){ var a=Math.atan2(me.y-mate.y,me.x-mate.x); moveTo(me.x+Math.cos(a)*900,me.y+Math.sin(a)*900); }
  }catch(e){}
},180);

/* 23. 🛡️ ANTI-VIRUS (z): evita i virus quando sei piccolo (non farti esplodere) */
function toggleAv(){ F.av=!F.av; zh60_toast(F.av?"🛡️ Anti-Virus ON":"🛡️ Anti-Virus OFF"); setStat("zev60-av",F.av&&!__zevPanic); }
setInterval(function(){
  if(!F.av||__zevPanic||window.__zevAntiCrash) return;
  try{
    var me=midSelf(); if(!me) return;
    var mm=sumMass(); if(mm>600) return;
    var v=nearestVirus(me.x,me.y,500); if(!v) return;
    var a=Math.atan2(me.y-v.y,me.x-v.x);
    moveTo(me.x+Math.cos(a)*800,me.y+Math.sin(a)*800);
  }catch(e){}
},200);

/* ── UI ── */
function setStat(id,on){ var el=document.getElementById(id); if(el){ el.textContent=on?"ON":"OFF"; el.style.color=on?"#ffd54d":"#aaa"; } }

  if(id==="minimap") toggleMap();
  else if(id==="aim") toggleAim();
  else if(id==="panic") togglePanic();
  else if(id==="ac") toggleAc();
  else if(id==="burst") toggleBurst();

  else if(id==="lock") toggleLock();
  else if(id==="gather") toggleGather();
  else if(id==="split") togglePsplit();
  else if(id==="merge") toggleMerge();
  else if(id==="mass") toggleMass();
  else if(id==="death") toggleDeath();
  else if(id==="mute") toggleMute();
  else if(id==="border") toggleBorder();
  else if(id==="spiral") toggleSpiral();
  else if(id==="protect") toggleProtect();
  else if(id==="restart") toggleRestart();
  else if(id==="vc") toggleVc();
  else if(id==="vs") toggleVs();
  else if(id==="vp") toggleVp();
  else if(id==="ft") toggleFt();
  else if(id==="fs") toggleFs();
  else if(id==="sc") toggleSc();
  else if(id==="eh") toggleEh();
  else if(id==="fk") toggleFk();
  else if(id==="pc") togglePc();
  else if(id==="wf") toggleWf();
  else if(id==="rf") toggleRf();
  else if(id==="gb") toggleGb();
  else if(id==="am") toggleAm();
  else if(id==="eb") toggleEb();
  else if(id==="fh") toggleFh();
  else if(id==="sh") toggleSh();
  else if(id==="th") toggleTh();
  else if(id==="gp") toggleGp();
  else if(id==="fm") toggleFm();
  else if(id==="zc") toggleZc();
  else if(id==="pe") togglePe();
  else if(id==="so") toggleSo();
  else if(id==="av") toggleAv();
  else zh60_toast("Sconosciuto: "+id);
}

/* ── 🔘 MASTER GLOBALE: accende/spegne tutte le funzioni in un colpo ── */
var ZE_ALL_IDS=["minimap","aim","panic","ac","burst","esc","lock","gather","split","merge","mass","death","mute","border","spiral","protect","restart","vc","vs","vp","ft","fs","sc","eh","fk","pc","wf","rf","gb","am","eb","fh","sh","th","gp","fm","zc","pe","so","av"];
function toggleAll(){
  var on=!F.all;
  F.all=on;
  for(var i=0;i<ZE_ALL_IDS.length;i++){
    var id=ZE_ALL_IDS[i];
    if(id==="panic") continue; // All-Stop resta a gestione sua
    F[id]=on;
    setStat("zev60-"+id, on&&!__zevPanic);
  }
  setStat("zev60-all", on);
  if(on){ // riattiva pannelli che dipendono da scelte singole
    if(F.minimap){ var m=document.getElementById("zev60-map"); if(m) m.style.display="block"; }
  }else{ // pulizia allo spegnimento
    if(rsTimer){ clearTimeout(rsTimer); rsTimer=null; } rsState=0;
    zh70_hud([]);
  }
  zh60_toast(on?"🟢 MASTER ON — tutte le 40 funzioni attive":"🔴 MASTER OFF — tutte spente");
}

  fab.textContent="🔰 ZE 7.0";
  fab.title="40 funzioni: Vacuum · Virus Shield · Virus Pop · Feed Team · Feed Smallest · Safe Center · Edge Hunter · Finish Kill · Pacifist · Wander · Rich · Growth · Ambush · Escape Burst · FPS/Size/Threat HUD · Grid Patrol · Force Merge · Zone · Picky · Solo · Anti-Virus · Auto-Restart";
  document.body.appendChild(fab);

  var pop=document.createElement("div"); pop.id="zev60-pop";
  pop.style.cssText="display:none;position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:48px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:232px;max-height:72vh;overflow:auto;z-index:2147483003;background:rgba(9,11,15,.95);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:12px;padding:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.6)";
  var head=document.createElement("div");

  head.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#ffd54d;flex:1">🔰 ZE 7.0</span><span class="zev60-x" style="cursor:pointer;color:#ffd54d;font-size:13px">✖</span>';
  pop.appendChild(head);

}

/* ── hotkeys ── */
document.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){
  if(e.target&&(e.target.tagName==="INPUT"||e.target.tagName==="TEXTAREA"||e.target.tagName==="SELECT")) return;
  if(e.ctrlKey||e.altKey||e.metaKey) return;
  var s=loadS(), k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  if(e.shiftKey){
    var smap={};
    smap[(s.muKey||"shift+m").toLowerCase()]="mute";
    smap[(s.bgKey||"shift+b").toLowerCase()]="border";
    smap[(s.spKey||"shift+f").toLowerCase()]="spiral";
    smap[(s.prKey||"shift+p").toLowerCase()]="protect";
    smap[(s.rsKey||"shift+r").toLowerCase()]="restart";
    var combo="shift+"+k;
    if(smap[combo]){ e.preventDefault(); toggle(smap[combo]); }
    return;
  }
  var map={};
  map[s.mmKey||"8"]="minimap";
  map[s.aimKey||"9"]="aim";
  map[s.panicKey||"0"]="panic";
  map[s.acKey||"6"]="ac";
  map[s.xbKey||"a"]="burst";
  map[s.aeKey||"e"]="esc";
  map[s.klKey||"r"]="lock";
  map[s.agKey||"f"]="gather";
  map[s.psKey||"t"]="split";
  map[s.smKey||"v"]="merge";
  map[s.maKey||"1"]="mass";
  map[s.daKey||"3"]="death";
  map[s.vcKey||"g"]="vc";
  map[s.vsKey||"x"]="vs";
  map[s.vpKey||"y"]="vp";
  map[s.ftKey||"w"]="ft";
  map[s.fsKey||"b"]="fs";
  map[s.scKey||"c"]="sc";
  map[s.ehKey||"h"]="eh";
  map[s.fkKey||"k"]="fk";
  map[s.pcKey||"p"]="pc";
  map[s.wfKey||"q"]="wf";
  map[s.rfKey||"d"]="rf";
  map[s.gbKey||"s"]="gb";
  map[s.amKey||"m"]="am";
  map[s.ebKey||"o"]="eb";
  map[s.fhKey||"2"]="fh";
  map[s.shKey||"4"]="sh";
  map[s.thKey||"5"]="th";
  map[s.gpKey||"i"]="gp";
  map[s.fmKey||"n"]="fm";
  map[s.zcKey||"u"]="zc";
  map[s.peKey||"j"]="pe";
  map[s.soKey||"l"]="so";
  map[s.avKey||"z"]="av";
  if(map[k]){ e.preventDefault(); toggle(map[k]); }
});
